reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2029
reviews_list.review_title: It's absolutely a perfect place filled with different religions and different countries.

review_content.Placements: The important thing is that there are international placements for students, which is good to have, and they offer 25+ LPA. We have international students on our campus, and local IT MLCs like Infosys, Accenture also visit the campus, and the Pharmacy also has a great scope.
review_content.Infrastructure: Hostels are hygienic, and the food is also good. They maintain the hostel room good and clean everyday. The infrastructure is awesome, all the classrooms are equipped with smartboards and Wi-Fi facility and all the floors have separate restrooms for both genders, and playgrounds are also available.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: Placements of 2026 for Aditya.

review_content.Placements: 90% people are placed in top companies. So many of the students, like 60% students where placed in tier 3. Some of them got internships in their 3rd year at Walmart, etc. The highest package is 28 LPA, the lowest package is around 5 LPA, and the average package is around 13 LPA.
review_content.Infrastructure: The classrooms are very organized and fully equipped with Wi-Fi facilities. The library is fully organized and has fully updated books with Wi-Fi facilities and computers. There is a reference room where we can take our interviews with high-speed Wi-Fi.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: Aditya University review.

review_content.Placements: Aditya University has a placement rate of around 80 to 90 percent for recent batches. The highest package offered is about 35 to 45 LPA while the lowest is around 1.8 to 3 LPA and the average package is approximately 5 to 5.5 LPA. Top recruiters include TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Accenture, Deloitte, Amazon, IBM, Tech Mahindra, and companies from banking and FMCG sectors. Around 80 to 90 percent of students secure internships during their course. Common roles offered are software engineer, data analyst, system engineer, business analyst, marketing executive and management trainee.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Petroleum Technology - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: I don't know about placements that happened in 2015.

review_content.Placements: Only 40 % to 45% students are selected in campus placements. The highest package is around 10 LPA to 12 LPA, and the lowest package is around 4.5 LPA to 5.5 LPA. The top recruiting companies are Lasern, Turbo, Halliburton, Tech Mahindra, Infosys, and GAIL.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure in this college is good, I like it, but we don't get a mobile signal in this college. The labs are good, and the equipment is available. There is a big library in this college, but the college's hostel food is really bad. I left the college hostel and joined an outside private hostel because of the worst food in the college hostel.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Data Science) - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: It is a truly exceptional college.

review_content.Placements: 83.8 percent of students get placed in my branch. The highest package offered in this branch ranges from 35-36 LPA. The top recruiting companies for our course are IBM, Wipro, Amazon, etc. Nearly 70 percent of students got internships in companies like Walmart, Flipkart, etc.
review_content.Infrastructure: We have the best classrooms and labs with the best systems and AC rooms. We have almost 3 libraries, each for a couple of blocks. Our hostel food menu changes when students get bored with eating it. They ask for reviews of food every day and change according to them. We have a very active team in sports where students are encouraged to participate in every event. There are also athletic coaches, especially for hostellers.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: Aditya University is an awesome college.

review_content.Placements: Placements are good. Many companies hire students from this college. The highest package offered to a diploma student is 8 LPA, and for the B.Tech, it is up to 15 LPA. Internships are also provided by various companies.
review_content.Infrastructure: The hostel facility is available for both girls and boys separately. The hostel infrastructure is good, with no disturbance and good food. Twice a week, non-vegetarian food is provided. We have a temple for different religions.

admission_process.title: Aditya University Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: Aditya University admission 2025is open for BTech, MTech, MCA, MBA and PhD courses. The university offers BTech, MTech, BBA, etc., courses at the UG and PG level. Apart from the UG and PG courses, the university also offers diploma and PhD courses. To be admitted toAditya University, candidates must meet the eligibility criteria set by the university. The application process at Aditya University is an offline procedure. Read the following article to know more about theAditya University course admission2025.

Aditya University admission 2025is entrance-based. The university accepts entrance exams for admission to various courses. The courses are available in multiple streams such as Engineering, Management, Computer Application etc. Check out the following table for details aroundAditya University course admissions2025:

Category A seats shall be 70% of the sanctioned intake of seats in each course and Category B seats shall be 30% of the total intake of seats in each course. Candidates are required to apply online on the official website of the university. Students can also check the detailedAditya University feestructure here.
STEP 2: Selection Rounds
Students will be selected based on entrance exam scores as per respective courses. However, for the rest of the courses, the selection criteria are entrance-based.

faqs.answer: No, candidates are not allowed for direct admission at Aditya University. For BTech course admission, candidates must meet the eligibility criteria set by the university. Aspiarnts should pass Class 12 with a 45% aggregate with Physics & Mathematics as compulsory subjects. The admission criteria for the course is AP EAMCET + Counselling/Merit.

Apart from the selection criteria, candidates must complete Class 12 with a 45% aggregate with Physics & Mathematics as compulsory subjects.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: College is decent, but if you have a good score, find better options.

review_content.Placements: I am doing a BE in mechanical engineering at Ajeenkya Dy Patil School of Engineering in Pune. This is a decent college, according to the cut-off. College is average according to the package. The average package here in mechanical engineering is about 3-4 LPA. Many average and some good companies visit the campus, but not all students get a good package on campus, it is decent according to the cut-off. Nestled, Wipro, Tata Motors, TCS, and HDFC Life companies like this have picked students from our college with a good package, but it can also be off-campus.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: The curly tables of ADYPU.

review_content.Placements: As of now, the college placement doesn't seem good to me, like the placement rates are very low, to be honest. Mostly, the company doesn't take mass recruitment from the college. The highest package that I know is somewhere around 50 LPA. The good thing is that college provides placement preparation. The lowest I would say was around 5 LPA.
review_content.Infrastructure: The college has good infrastructure, but it doesn't seem to work every time. For example, we have Wi-Fi everywhere in college, but it doesn't give the desired speed for completing your work. The classrooms and library are good. The hostel infrastructure is good, but guests have the same problem of not having good facilities. Even the mess food is not included in the hostel, so you have to buy it. Medical facilities are not that good, but they will work.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Engineering (System Engineering) - Batch of 2029
reviews_list.review_title: Absolutely satisfied because of faculty members, excellent placements in 2024, and really good.

review_content.Placements: College placements for my course are about 65%, and the university assured us about the placements. The highest package is 55 LPA, and the lowest is around 12 LPA. Internship opportunities are pushed, the seniors say there are many internship programs. Companies such as Tata, Infosys, Wipro, Google, Amazon, etc.
review_content.Infrastructure: Facilities of the university have been top-notch. It has excellent campus. We have simple and clean classrooms. There is a spacious library. A lot of indoor facilities are also provided. Hostel is 4/5, there are a lot of cafes around the campus so it has become a hangout spot in leisure time. Sports facilities have been solid, good coaches, separate grounds for every sport, such as basketball court, pickleball court, football ground, and cricket ground.

reviews_list.batch_info: Discontinued (Feb-26) B.Tech. in Computer Engineering (Information Systems) - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: If you are seeking a decent placement and good faculty members, you can go with ADYPU.

review_content.Placements: ADYPU offers impressive infrastructure, supportive faculty members, and good placement. Apart from the job, ADYPU also ensures to build and boost your skills and to make you industry-ready. In 2025, many of my seniors grabbed high-paying jobs and internships.
review_content.Infrastructure: Our college provides good infrastructure, and also study environment is pretty much happening. As of 2025, the classrooms and study environment are also very good. Hostel facility is also nice, and rooms are big enough for you not to have any trouble. If you are well-skilled to make a good company around you, then the years of hostel life will also be fun.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Com (Hons.) - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: Strong placements and a great place to learn.

review_content.Placements: The placement cell at our university is quite proactive. It starts preparing us from the third year itself with aptitude training, mock interviews, and resume-building workshops. For our course 85 percent of students who opt for placements get placed successfully. The highest package offered is around 18 LPA from a major product-based company while the lowest is 3.5 LPA.
review_content.Infrastructure: Our department has modern classrooms equipped with smart boards and projectors. The entire campus is Wi-Fi enabled with decent speed, which is a great help for research and project work. Labs are excellent. We have specialized labs for various domains, including an Apple Lab for iOS development, a Data Science lab with high-end systems, and robotics labs. The central library is huge and well-stocked with a vast collection of books, journals, and digital resources.

reviews_list.batch_info: Discontinued (Feb-26) B.Tech. in Computer Engineering (Information Systems) - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: Strong placements, supportive faculty, and a modern campus for tech enthusiasts.

review_content.Placements: I am satisfied with the placement opportunities in the B.Tech computer science course at Ajeenkya DY Patil University. About 70-97 percent of us got placed with the highest package reaching 1.2 crore per annum and average offers in the 4.5 LPA - 6.5 LPA range. Top recruiters include TCS, Infosys, Amazon, Accenture and Wipro. Around 70-90 percent of students also secured internships at leading organizations like ISRO, DRDO, Google and Microsoft. The main roles offered are software engineer, data analyst and full stack developer. Overall the course offers good industry exposure and career growth opportunities.

content.Placements: College placements for my course are about 65%, and the university assured us about the placements. The highest package is 55 LPA, and the lowest is around 12 LPA. Internship opportunities are pushed, the seniors say there are many internship programs. Companies such as Tata, Infosys, Wipro, Google, Amazon, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities of the university have been top-notch. It has excellent campus. We have simple and clean classrooms. There is a spacious library. A lot of indoor facilities are also provided. Hostel is 4/5, there are a lot of cafes around the campus so it has become a hangout spot in leisure time. Sports facilities have been solid, good coaches, separate grounds for every sport, such as basketball court, pickleball court, football ground, and cricket ground.

individual_reviews.course: Discontinued (Feb-26) B.Tech. in Computer Engineering (Information Systems) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: If you are seeking a decent placement and good faculty members, you can go with ADYPU.

content.Placements: ADYPU offers impressive infrastructure, supportive faculty members, and good placement. Apart from the job, ADYPU also ensures to build and boost your skills and to make you industry-ready. In 2025, many of my seniors grabbed high-paying jobs and internships.
content.Infrastructure: Our college provides good infrastructure, and also study environment is pretty much happening. As of 2025, the classrooms and study environment are also very good. Hostel facility is also nice, and rooms are big enough for you not to have any trouble. If you are well-skilled to make a good company around you, then the years of hostel life will also be fun.

individual_reviews.course: B.Com (Hons.) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Strong placements and a great place to learn.

content.Placements: The placement cell at our university is quite proactive. It starts preparing us from the third year itself with aptitude training, mock interviews, and resume-building workshops. For our course 85 percent of students who opt for placements get placed successfully. The highest package offered is around 18 LPA from a major product-based company while the lowest is 3.5 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: Our department has modern classrooms equipped with smart boards and projectors. The entire campus is Wi-Fi enabled with decent speed, which is a great help for research and project work. Labs are excellent. We have specialized labs for various domains, including an Apple Lab for iOS development, a Data Science lab with high-end systems, and robotics labs. The central library is huge and well-stocked with a vast collection of books, journals, and digital resources.

Further, students need to appear for a PI round followed by counselling for seat allotment. Students seeking to get into any of the offered courses are required to fulfil the eligibility requirements before applying. To get into Ajeenkya DY Patil University, students are required to go through several steps. These steps include application, entrance exam, selection rounds, counselling, & seat confirmation. As admissions to the courses offered at the university are entrance-based, students need to clear the ACET exam conducted by the university to be eligible for admission. The process mainly commences online. Interested students can follow the below-mentioned steps to complete theADYPU admission process:
Step 1: ADYPU Application Process 2026
Interested students can visit the university's official site & apply for the ACET exam by registering themselves. The application process commences online.
Step 2: ADYPU Selection Process 2026

AYDYPU selects students based on their performance in the ACET test. Aspirants must appear & clear the entrance exam to get into the desired course. It is also important that the students meet the course-specific admission criteria. Further, students need to appear for the personal interview rounds conducted at the university. For admission to the MBA programme, students need to appear for the Group Discussion (GD) rounds. Admission to the design courses is done on the basis of the Studio Test followed by other selection rounds.
Step 3:ADYPU Admission Confirmation
The university sends the Admission Offer Letter once the students are shortlisted. Students need to accept the letter & complete the admission process.

admission_process.title: Amity University Patna Admission Process 2026

paragraphs: Amity Patna admissionis a multi-step process. Candidates seeking for getting admission to UG/ PG courses of the university must go through a detailed Amity University Patna admission process. The university selects students based on selection criteria, which include filling the application form, qualifying for the selection rounds and payingAmity University Patna feesat the time of final admission.
1: Amity University Patna Application Process

The Amity University admission process begins by filling an application form on the official website of Amity University Patna. If candidates wish to apply for more than one programme, they need to fill out a separate form for each course by paying an application fee ofINR 1,500each. The new users are required to generate login credentials and fill an online application form with all the relevant details and documents and submit the form on the admission portal of Amity Patna.
2: Amity University Patna Selection Process

Amity Patna admissions are both merit and entrance-based. For most of the UG & PG courses, candidates are selected based on merit of the last qualifying exam of previous education. Further, the shortlisted candidates have to appear for the Personal Interview round, which is mandatory to qualify for admission to every course. Candidates have to qualify for exams such as CAT, MAT,GMAT, Amity- Joint Entrance Examination etc.
3: The Final Offer Letter

After the completion of all the selection rounds, the final result will be declared. The information concerning selection will be communicated on the admission microsite as well as via Email and SMS. Selected candidates will get an admission letter along with important information such as semester fee, class commencement date, time, venue of the course, allotment of a hostel (If applied), scholarship (If any) and the list of documents required at the time of joining. Candidates also have to pay for a certain amount as per theAmity Patna fees structureto secure their seat.

reviews_list.review_title: I am satisfied with what is happening.

review_content.Placements: 80 per cent are placed. 24 LPA is the highest package, 2 LPA is the lowest, and the average is 2.5 LPA. MuSigma is the highest recruiting company in the State. 30% of students got an internship at Wipro and TCS. Sales and Software engineer interns are offered.
review_content.Infrastructure: It's available in the course/department. Wi-Fi, Labs, classrooms and the library are present. I am not a hosteller, so I can't tell much about that, but my friends are, so the food is average for everyday purposes, else the mess, canteen and medical facilities are there.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: Great campus with excellent facilities and strict attendance.

review_content.Placements: 65 to 60 percent of students got placed last year. The lowest package is 3.5 LPA, the average is 6 LPA-10 LPA, and the highest is 35 LPA. Recruiting companies are Palo Alto, Infosys, and Ishan Technologies. 20 to 30 percent of students got internships from my course in TCS and Wipro. Software developer, cloud engineer, and data analyst are roles offered.
review_content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is quite good. Labs are not that good. Classrooms are fully air-conditioned, libraries are big, the quality of food is great, top medical facilities, and big grounds for each sport and game. Sometimes Wi-Fi stops working for 2 or 3 days. Labs are mainly considered as a free period.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: Review of campus life, which is exciting and amazing.

review_content.Placements: Approximately 95% of students get placed. The average package is 7 LPA. Students get placed in companies like Palo Alto, etc. Roles offered are awesome. The internship thing is also good on this campus. We get amazing opportunities. There is a good environment.
review_content.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure of the campus are awesome. We have a library, labs, an auditorium, etc. Medical facilities are also there. All facilities are good. It has an amazing mess.
review_content.Faculty: Teachers are so helpful and very qualified. Semester exams are not so difficult, but are at a good standard level. The course curriculum is good. Exams level is good. NIT-qualified teachers are teaching in our college. The book authors are also, and we are extremely honored there. Faculty members are very supportive, and they give us direction for our lives and also for placements.

reviews_list.batch_info: MBA in International Business - Batch of 2024
reviews_list.review_title: I am really blessed to be in this college.

review_content.Placements: On average, more than 83% of students get placed in our course. The highest package offered is 33 LPA, and the lowest package offered ranges from 6-10 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Amazon, Genpact, Cognizant, IBM, etc. The percentage of students who got internships is 83%.
review_content.Infrastructure: Facilities are top-notch. There is a Wi-Fi facility in all classrooms with a comfortable branch and library. The infrastructure is amazing, and each building has a library. The quality of facilities is available, and labs are well-equipped. Hostel facilities are good. There is good food in the hostel mess. Medical facilities are available. The quality of education is good.

reviews_list.batch_info: M.Sc. in Biotechnology - Batch of 2024
reviews_list.review_title: It is the best university in India with good placements.

review_content.Placements: The percentage of students who get placed in our Amity University is 98%. In our course, almost 93% of students got placed. The highest package offered is 52 LPA and the lowest package is 2.4 LPA. Companies like Bioneeds, BiOZEEN, Mankind, and GH visit the college and hire students. Internship opportunities are offered to students at Cipla and most of the students get jobs here.
review_content.Infrastructure: It provides facilities like Wi-Fi, parking, RO water, a sports room, and a library. We can only enter the library if we have a library ID card. It is easy to get a library ID card as we have to just fill form and attach the fee receipt. Classrooms are so clean. The infrastructure is amazing and I love it. Each department has different blocks with all facilities. Medical facilities are provided. The food in the canteen is very tasty.

reviews_list.review_title: My college life in short.

content.Placements: 65 to 60 percent of students got placed last year. The lowest package is 3.5 LPA, the average is 6 LPA-10 LPA, and the highest is 35 LPA. Recruiting companies are Palo Alto, Infosys, and Ishan Technologies. 20 to 30 percent of students got internships from my course in TCS and Wipro. Software developer, cloud engineer, and data analyst are roles offered.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is quite good. Labs are not that good. Classrooms are fully air-conditioned, libraries are big, the quality of food is great, top medical facilities, and big grounds for each sport and game. Sometimes Wi-Fi stops working for 2 or 3 days. Labs are mainly considered as a free period.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Review of campus life, which is exciting and amazing.

content.Placements: Approximately 95% of students get placed. The average package is 7 LPA. Students get placed in companies like Palo Alto, etc. Roles offered are awesome. The internship thing is also good on this campus. We get amazing opportunities. There is a good environment.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure of the campus are awesome. We have a library, labs, an auditorium, etc. Medical facilities are also there. All facilities are good. It has an amazing mess.
content.Faculty: Teachers are so helpful and very qualified. Semester exams are not so difficult, but are at a good standard level. The course curriculum is good. Exams level is good. NIT-qualified teachers are teaching in our college. The book authors are also, and we are extremely honored there. Faculty members are very supportive, and they give us direction for our lives and also for placements.

individual_reviews.course: MBA in International Business - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: I am really blessed to be in this college.

content.Placements: On average, more than 83% of students get placed in our course. The highest package offered is 33 LPA, and the lowest package offered ranges from 6-10 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Amazon, Genpact, Cognizant, IBM, etc. The percentage of students who got internships is 83%.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities are top-notch. There is a Wi-Fi facility in all classrooms with a comfortable branch and library. The infrastructure is amazing, and each building has a library. The quality of facilities is available, and labs are well-equipped. Hostel facilities are good. There is good food in the hostel mess. Medical facilities are available. The quality of education is good.

individual_reviews.course: M.Sc. in Biotechnology - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: It is the best university in India with good placements.

content.Placements: The percentage of students who get placed in our Amity University is 98%. In our course, almost 93% of students got placed. The highest package offered is 52 LPA and the lowest package is 2.4 LPA. Companies like Bioneeds, BiOZEEN, Mankind, and GH visit the college and hire students. Internship opportunities are offered to students at Cipla and most of the students get jobs here.
content.Infrastructure: It provides facilities like Wi-Fi, parking, RO water, a sports room, and a library. We can only enter the library if we have a library ID card. It is easy to get a library ID card as we have to just fill form and attach the fee receipt. Classrooms are so clean. The infrastructure is amazing and I love it. Each department has different blocks with all facilities. Medical facilities are provided. The food in the canteen is very tasty.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with what is happening.
reviews.review_text: It's available in the course/department. Wi-Fi, Labs, classrooms and the library are present. I am not a hosteller, so I can't tell much about that, but my friends are, so the food is average for everyday purposes, else the mess, canteen and medical facilities are there.

reviews.review_heading: Great campus with excellent facilities and strict attendance.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is quite good. Labs are not that good. Classrooms are fully air-conditioned, libraries are big, the quality of food is great, top medical facilities, and big grounds for each sport and game. Sometimes Wi-Fi stops working for 2 or 3 days. Labs are mainly considered as a free period.

reviews.review_heading: Review of campus life, which is exciting and amazing.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure of the campus are awesome. We have a library, labs, an auditorium, etc. Medical facilities are also there. All facilities are good. It has an amazing mess.

reviews.review_heading: I am really blessed to be in this college.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are top-notch. There is a Wi-Fi facility in all classrooms with a comfortable branch and library. The infrastructure is amazing, and each building has a library. The quality of facilities is available, and labs are well-equipped. Hostel facilities are good. There is good food in the hostel mess. Medical facilities are available. The quality of education is good.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best university in India with good placements.
reviews.review_text: It provides facilities like Wi-Fi, parking, RO water, a sports room, and a library. We can only enter the library if we have a library ID card. It is easy to get a library ID card as we have to just fill form and attach the fee receipt. Classrooms are so clean. The infrastructure is amazing and I love it. Each department has different blocks with all facilities. Medical facilities are provided. The food in the canteen is very tasty.

reviews.review_heading: My college life in short.
reviews.review_text: Everything is available. Staff and all are so good. Also, wardens are very supportive. Food is really tasty. All sports are available and coaches are also allotted. We have Wi-Fi and classes are very comfortable. Our campus has best environment for learning. Library has all the necessary resources. The campus is also very beautiful and we are allowed to walk freely.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure, helpful faculty, and decent placements, but more industry exposure is needed.
reviews.review_text: Amity University Gwalior offered good Wi-Fi, modern labs, smart classrooms, and a well-stocked library. Hostels were clean with decent rooms, the mess food was average, the canteen had a variety, medical help was available, and sports facilities were well-maintained.

reviews.review_heading: It is one of the best universities in our state.
reviews.review_text: The university offers separate hostels for male and female students, with options for single, double, or triple occupancy. Rooms are fully furnished with beds, study tables, wardrobes, and chairs. It is equipped with 24x7 high-speed Wi-Fi connectivity.

reviews.review_heading: It has very good infrastructure, has Ph.D. qualified teachers', and placements are good.
reviews.review_text: Amity University has a very good and attractive infrastructure, which is comfortable for students to survive in various places. They have digital classrooms and a fully air-conditioned campus, which is very comfortable for students. They also have a lift facility.

reviews.review_heading: I will recommend this college to all the people who want some good opportunities.
reviews.review_text: Amity University Gwalior has incredible infrastructure on all campuses. The hostel facilities are also good. The food tastes amazing. Labs have all-new equipment. The Wi-Fi speed is amazing it connects all around. On campus, every area is covered with Wi-Fi. The library is also good and all the spots have fast access of Wi-Fi.

reviews.review_heading: The infrastructure is good, and the hostel and mess are average.
reviews.review_text: Hostels were good but a bit costly for everyone, I guess. The food was usually average, not that good, not that bad, but it was just sufficient for you to live. Then we came to the infrastructure, which was really good. They provided great surroundings to live in. We have too many activities that keep going around which will help you to find your space anyhow.

reviews.review_heading: Amity is a synonym of success.
reviews.review_text: The college has Wi-Fi, labs, etc. I love it. Classrooms are structured. The library is very good. Classrooms are AC. We have an ambulance. Doctors are available for contingency. The college has a photo lab, TV lab,  cinema lab, and editing lab. They have cameras and lights.

reviews.review_heading: We have a great campus and life.
reviews.review_text: The college has studio labs, a photos lab, an editing lab, an animation lab, a fact check lab, a library, a Wi-Fi, lab, ICT-enabled classes, an AC campus, and a well-equipped gym. The quality of the mess is good and the hostel cab opted with and without AC. The college provides 24x7 power supply. Doctors are available throughout the year.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best place to grow and study.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is very good and positive. It has anticipated and sophisticated classrooms, spacious sports facilities, and well-equipped labs. Campuses are frequently large and kept up nicely. Although opinions differ, many emphasize good Wi-Fi and sufficient facilities. The environment is very positive there.

reviews.review_heading: It has good infrastructure and good campus.
reviews.review_text: On the campus, Wi-Fi is available. The library is available. Classrooms are fully furnished, and labs are good. The hostel infrastructure is good. Medical facilities are good. The mess food is good. Rules in the hostel are just like jail, which is only one negative thing in the hostel. The infrastructure is good.

admission_process.title: Amity University Ranchi Admission Process 2026

paragraphs: Amity University admissions begin in January and continue till July. Amity University, Ranchi existed in 2016 and functions under the Amity Group of Institutions. Two names know it— either Amity University Jharkhand or Amity University Ranchi.Amity University Ranchioffers undergraduate and postgraduate courses inEngineering, Management, Commerce, Computers, andLaw. The admission to all courses is done based on academic record, score in the Amity written test, and performance in the personal interview. For an MBA, candidates must also clear the Management Aptitude Test. It is only after clearing all these stages that students will be given an offer of admission.

Amity University Ranchi course admissions 2026is currently open. Amity Ranchi admissions are offeredentrance-based. Amity University Ranchi admission for MBA is based on a valid score of entrance exams such asCAT/MAT/GMATother than that all direct admission is offered based on the merit performance of candidates. Interested candidates can visit the official website to apply for the course of their choice. Candidates can read the table below to learn more about Amity University admission highlights:

Amity University, Ranchi admission is open for all UG and PG courses. The duration of UG courses is three years, whereas PG courses are of two-year duration. Admission to all the courses is merit and entrance-based. The table below has theAmity University Ranchi courseseligibility and selection criteria:

Amity Ranchi admission is a multi-step process. Candidates seeking for getting admission to UG/ PG courses of the university must go through a detailed Amity University Ranchi admission process. To admit the right candidates, the university selects students based on selection criteria, which include filling the application form, qualifying for the selection rounds and paying for the Amity University Ranchi fees at the time of final admission.
Step 1: Amity University Ranchi Application Process 2026

The Amity University admission process begins by filling out an application form on the official website of Amity University Ranchi. If candidates wish to apply for more than one programme, they need to fill out a separate form for each course by paying an application fee ofINR 1,500each. The new users are required to generate login credentials fill an online application form with all the relevant details and documents and submit the form on the admission portal of Amity Ranchi.
Step 2: Amity University Ranchi Selection Process

Amity Ranchi admissions are both merit and entrance-based. For most of the UG & PG courses, candidates are selected based on merit of the last qualifying exam of previous education. Further, the shortlisted candidates have to appear for the Personal Interview round, which is mandatory to qualify for admission to every course. Candidates have to qualify for exams such as Amity- Joint Entrance Examination etc.
Step 3: The Final Offer Letter

After the completion of all the selection rounds, the final result will be declared. The information concerning selection will be communicated on the admission microsite as well as via Email and SMS. Selected candidates will get an admission letter along with important information such as semester fee, class commencement date, time, venue of the course, allotment of a hostel (If applied), scholarship (If any) and the list of documents required at the time of joining. Candidates also have to pay a certain amount as per the Amity Ranchi fees structure to secure their seats.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the faculty. Placements were good in 2023. It has a beautiful campus.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and environment.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good, like all necessary items are provided on campus and hostel, like good purified water, and for summer, it is chilled, then the whole campus is air-conditioned, and the labs which are given to us are well-updated with current technologies.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Nice place for learning new things.
reviews.review_text: Facilities given to us include a library with books from all domains, labs with up-to-date technologies and specifications, Wi-Fi in the whole campus, smart classrooms for live coding or demonstrations, air-conditioned rooms, and many more. I don't have any idea about the hostel.

reviews.review_heading: Good for those who can't go outside of Jharkhand or Ranchi.

reviews.review_heading: Good environment for learning skills.

reviews.review_heading: Review for future ones.

overview_faqs.answer: The online/distance degrees offered by the Centre for Distance and Online Education at Annamalai University are valid. However, Annamalai University DDE received relief from the Madras High Court in an order dated 21.01.2023. content.Placements: The placement was good, but not with very big companies. You can't get a good job with a decent package. I'm just studying in third year, so I don't know much about placements. individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2018

content.Placements: Around 60%-70% of students from the B.E. Civil course got placed. The highest package offered is around 6 LPA, the lowest is around 2 LPA, and the average is about 3.5 LPA. Common roles include content writers, research assistants, and HR trainees.

admission_process.title: Annamalai University Admission Process 2026

paragraphs: Annamalai University admission 2026 includes the submission of an application form, appearance for the entrance test, the release of the merit list, the counselling process and fee payment. students can follow the -wise Annamalai University admission process as given below:
1: Annamalai University Application Process 2026

The university accepts applications via online mode. Eligible students can visit the university's official website (www.annamalaiuniversity.ac.in) to apply. Further, the aspirants shall ensure that they apply within the due date.
2: Appear for the Entrance Test

If a student fills out the initial application process, they now have to appear for the course-specific entrance test. For undergraduate engineering, i.e., BTech course, students should turn out for the Tamil Nadu Engineering Admissions (TNEA).
3: Release of the Merit List
Based on the entrance test scores, the University will release the merit list of eligible students for the next round of the admission process.
4: Counselling & Fee Payment

In this , students whose names appeared in the merit list released by the University are then required to appear for the counselling process. After the counselling round, Annamalai University released a final list of selected students for final admission. Selected students are then required to pay theAnnamalai University admission feeto confirm their admission.

Annamalai University fee is cumulative of multiple components, such as tuition fee, hostel fee, etc. Some of the fee components are charged one-time, while some have to be paid semester-wise or annually, such as tuition fees. college_info.intro:
Army Institute of Technology offers 5 UG level and 1 PG level courses to the students. PhD in Computer Engineering is also given by AIT Pune. UG level Engineering courses like B.E. are the most popular programmes offered to the students. The courses include B.E Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering, B.E Computer Engineering, B.E Information Technology, etc. The duration of these courses are of 4 years with the seat intake ranging from 60 to 120 depending on the stream. Well qualified faculty are there to help students in attaining highest standards in academics and professional skills. The Institute gives all the required facilities like Laboratories, Library, etc to help student to get both practical and theoretical knowledge.
After the completion of the B.E programmes, the students get the opportunities to work in the fields like, IT services, Software Development, Consulting, Retail & FMG, etc. Students can also go in Government sector or get higher degree like M.E. Highly active placement cell helps students to get desired internships and placements in top recruiting companies.

placements.overview:
The mode of Army Institute of Technology course admission is online. The students need to fill the application form released by the college to take part in the admission process. Wards of serving/ retired Army/ Navy/ Air Force personnel are eligible to apply for admission to AIT.

For UG level courses students need minimum of 45% in Class 12 or equivalent in Science Stream. AIT admission is based on the All India Ranking in JEE (Main) and some weightage is given for wards of disabled Soldiers, War Widows and Gallantry Award winners.

For PG level courses students need to have bachelor's degree in Engineering / Technology in an eligible branch with a minimum score of 50%. The applications of students with valid non-zero GATE score are considered first. For PhD students require a Master's degree () in a relevant discipline and meeting SPPU's criteria. individual_reviews.title: This is a good college to consider.

content.Placements: The placements in this college are good. The 4th-year students are getting gold packages. Apple also came to this college. The average package of the IT and Comp is good compared to other branches. ENTC is also good. If you are coming here, take IT or Comp.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of this college is good. The main building of this college is also good. There is a 4th-year hostel which was made recently. It is the best hostel in this college. It has a lift. We have a college gym that is common for all, and girls have their own gym in their hostel.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Strengthened coding culture and good placement.

content.Placements: 98 percent of students in my course computer engineering are placed last year 2025. The highest package is 52 LPA, the lowest is around 3.3 LPA, the average is around 12 LPA and the mean is 9 LPA. Top recruiting companies were Apple, Google, Microsoft, BNY Mellon, Mastercard and Cred. The percentage of students who got internships is around 100 percent.
content.Infrastructure: We have specialized labs and smart education facilities, 24/7 Wi-Fi and a library. We have good hostel amenities and system and we also have other facilities like gyms, clean rooms and modern facilities. Mess food is also good. College is provided with special sports equipment and medical rooms.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: The campus size should be larger.

content.Placements: 95 to 97 percent students got placement. The highest package offered is 54 LPA, the average package offered is 11.5 LPA in our branch. Top recruiters are Cred. I do not know the percentage of internships but internships are good over here. In my course we can choose both core and software fields because in the ENTC branch, computer language and electronics hardware are taught.
content.Infrastructure: In our college Wi-Fi is not good but classes, library, hostels and mess food are good. Canteen and medical facilities are nice. The campus is small, gym and barber facilities are free and prices of groceries and juices are low as compared to the market. It is value for money.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Really good college, a little world with many hopes.

content.Placements: 100 percent are placed in my course. The highest package offered is 52 LPA. Top recruitment companies are JP Morgan, Cred, Mastercard, etc. The average package offered in this college is 11 to 14 LPA which is really good and should attract admissions to this college.
content.Infrastructure: The Infrastructure is good. The hostels are also very nice especially the 4th year hostel, which looks good from the outside and is excellent from the inside. The food quality is superb. There is a cafe a canteen and small shops on the campus. All the laundry and haircuts are included in the fees as well as the cleaning of rooms. All kinds of sport facility is available, with volleyball courts, kabaddi courts, squash courts, badminton, lawn tennis, table tennis, basketball courts, football and cricket grounds etc. The college heavily promotes sports. The medical facility is also freely available 24/7.

paragraphs: Army Institute of Technology, Pune (AIT, Pune) has concluded its placements season for its academic year of 2019-2020 with 92 per cent placements record. During AIT, Pune placements 2020, the highest and the average offered were Rs 39 LPA and Rs 7.30 LPA, respectively.

Every year, around 70 companies visit the campus to participate in the Institute's placements drive. In 2020, out of 342 students who registered for placements, 313 were successfully placed by 68 different companies. Every year, more than 10 new companies join the list of AIT, Pune recruiters. Additionally, as per the placement rankings of Pune University, AIT Pune has secured Rank 3.

admission_process.title: BIT Sindri Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: BIT Sindri admission processincludes multiple steps. Students have to start by applying for the course of their choice. The institute considers entrance exam scores of the Students for admission. Below is a step-wise BIT Sindri admission process:
BIT Sindri Application Process 2025

Students have to fill JEECE application form to apply for counselling for BTech programme. For other courses, MTech and PhD, Students need to download the application form from the institute and submit it offline or apply online on the official website of the institute. Aspirants also need to pay an application fee to register for the course.
Selection Process

Once the registration is done, aspirants need to appear for JEE Main.GATEscore is considered for admission to MTech programme. Aspirants applying for MTech can also appear for the entrance exam conducted by the institute. BIT may also conduct a personal interview round for selected students. For PhD admission, aspirants need to appear for BIT written test followed by a personal interview round.
Merit List and Counselling

Once selected, BIT Sindri releases a merit list. Aspirants with their names in the merit list are required to participate in counselling and document verification rounds. BTech students need to register forJEECE Counsellingfor seat allotment. Shortlisted students are required to pay the course fee to confirm their seat in the institute.

BIT Sindri fee is a sum of multiple components, such as tuition fee, hostel fee and one-time fee. The components in the total fee vary with the course selected by the students. Check below the course-wiseBIT Sindri feeand average package:

The institute underBML Munjal University (BMU)offers four-year BTech course in three specialisations. Interested candidates can apply online on the official website of the institute.
BMS Munjal University Admission Open:Apply Now

School of Engineering and Technology of BML offers BTech courses in Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science & Engineering and Electronics & Communication Engineering. Below is the eligibility and selection criteria forSOET, BML Munjal University courses:
School of Engineering and Technology offers admission to BTech courses based on entrance exam scores. Candidates need to follow the below steps to get a seat in the institute:
STEP 1:Candidates meeting the eligibility criteria can apply online for the preferred BTech course. Aspirants also need to pay an application fee to register for the course.
STEP 2:The selection for BTech is based on JEE Main, SAT, CUET or BMU-SAT score. Candidates applying for BTech via JEE Main must score a minimum of 60 percentile to get admission.

STEP 3:Once selected, candidates are called for document verification. The institute informs the aspirants about their selection via email. Shortlisted candidates need to pay a course fee to confirm their seat in the institute.

BMSIT Bangalore offers 10+ UG and PG-level courses with BE as their flagship course and NIRF ranking of 151-200. faqs.question: How can I get admission at BMS Institute of Technology and Management?

content.Placements: The placement in our course was the best among all courses. The placement percentage was around 85–90 percent. The highest package was also secured by our course only, i.e., 22 LPA. The average package was around 5 LPA. Top recruiting companies were Accenture, Deloitte, etc.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure available for our course were extremely good. Wi-Fi facilities, a library, and modern classrooms were available. Computer labs, laboratories, and workshops were well equipped with instruments. Hostel quality was also good. Sports and games were encouraged by the college.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Our college gives the best education and skills.

content.Placements: I am currently in my 3rd year. My super seniors got normal jobs in companies. But still, our college management is trying to give the best jobs to the students. 40 percent of students were placed in my college. The highest package is 8 LPA, and the lowest package is 2 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: The best thing about my college is the hostel. They provide two different types of food, like northern and southern style food. I have tried both types of food, but North-style food is better than South-style. I can give 4 stars out of 5 stars to my college hostel facilities.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Colorful campus and opportunity to grow

content.Placements: I joined in September. In our class there are 60 students and many other sections. I have heard from seniors that the average package is around 3 to 4 LPA. Mostly small and midfirm companies are coming and intership is not so mandatory. It mostly will depend on our skills and our willingness to learn.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-fi is available and a full network. Computer labs are there for learning communication and presentation. Classrooms have AC and best seats to attend classes. I am not a hosteler but I have eaten once. I did not like it so much. Good enough to live. Sports facilities are the best. You can play basketball cricket tennis and coaches are there. A small hospital is there for small health issues.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Good placements and fantastic infrastructure, but the hostel mess food is just average.

content.Placements: For our BBA batch, the placement rate is quite high, officially around 90%. The salary packages have a wide range. The highest package goes up to 13.60 LPA. The median package is 4.00 LPA. On average, most students receive offers between 2.5 LPA and 3.5 LPA, with the lowest packages being around 1.5 LPA. Our top recruiting companies include major banks like ICICI, HDFC, and Axis Bank. As well as IT companies like Accenture, Wipro, and Cognizant. Almost everyone, 60-100 percent, manages to get an internship as it is a key part of our course.

paragraphs: Centurion University Paralakhemundi admission 2024is online and offline. Centurion University of Technology and Management (CUTM), through eight schools, offers UG, PG, and other courses to students across Engineering, Management, Science, and other streams. Admission to various UG, PG, and other courses is based on merit and scores secured in entrance exams. At the UG level,Centurion University Paralakhemundioffers four-year BTech, four-year BSc, three-year BCA, BBA, and other courses to students.

At the PG level, the university offers two-year MBA, MSc, and other courses to students. To get admission to any courses students are required to complete the eligibility and selection criteria set by the college for admission. Want to know more about Centurion University Paralakhemundi admission, along with course-wise eligibility, selection criteria, seat intake, fees and admission process:

Students seeking admission are advised to check the course-specific eligibility conditions before applying. The final seat allotment is done only for students who meet eligibility and selection criteria. To confirm admission, selected candidates have to pay some amount of the course fees at the time of admission. The table presentsCenturion University Paralakhemundi coursesalong with course eligibility and selection criteria:

Centurion University Paralakhemundi feeis a sum of multiple components such as tuition fee, caution deposit, exam fee, etc. Some of the fee components like caution deposit are one-time paid while tuition fee is paid annually. Coming to affordability is one of the strong reasons why many don't opt for a degree or a college. While the availability of education loans and scholarships has made education accessible. However, the terms and conditions required to become eligible for a student loan or a scholarship often stand as a challenge. Centurion University Paralakhemundi seat intakevaries course-wise. Candidates are offered seats based on their merit. Once the seat is allotted, candidates are required to pay the course fee to confirm their admission. Below is the intake for top Centurion University Paralakhemundi courses:
Note:This information is sourced from the official website/ sanctioning body and is subject to change.

Centurion University follows a process for admissions to its various courses. Each aspirant goes through the admission stages till the final seat allotment. Largely, the admission process involves an application process, entrance examination, counselling, and admission confirmation. Details on each of these admission stages are provided below for a better understanding of the students:
STEP 1: Centurion University Paralakhemundi Application Process2024

Candidates willing to get admission to Centurion University can apply forCUEEfrom the official website with an option to pay and submit the form online or pay and submit the form offline. The aspirants opting for the online application method are required to visit the official website of the University(www.cutm.ac.in).

After the completion of registration, the University will conduct the CUEE exam. Applicants are required to appear for the exam at the notified test centre. Qualified applicants will be called up to take provisional admission by depositing a minimum admission fee via cash/DD at the University campus or online on the website.
STEP 2: Shortlisting Students

Centurion University Entrance Examination (CUEE) is conducted by Centurion University, Odisha for admissions to various undergraduate and postgraduate courses. The online remote-proctored test is a 3-hour long exam. The students with a valid score and meeting the cutoff are called for the next round of admission. For MTech courses, national-level exams, andGATEscores are accepted for shortlisting students.
STEP 3: Counselling

Candidates who score greater than or equal to the cutoff marks in the entrance examination have to participate in theCUEE counsellingprocess for admissions. The counselling is conducted in offline mode. The selected students have to report to the counselling venue and fill out their preferred courses. The seat allotment is done based on the candidate's merit, preference and availability of seats.
STEP 4: Admission Fee Payment & Seat Confirmation
After the final seat allotments, selected students can pay some amount of the admission fee and confirm their seats. The amount required to be paid can be confirmed by the university officials.

admission_process.title: CGC University Admission Process 2026

paragraphs: CGC University has a dedicated admission cell to assist the admission process. The objective of this cell is to guide potential students in making the selection from the different courses available at the university. Follow the steps forCGC University admission processgiven below:
Application Process
Interested students can register themselves at the CGC University website by submitting an application form. The form has to be submitted with required documents and an application fees.

The selection of a student for a particular course depends on the profile. Aspirants need to have a qualifying score in the minimum qualification required to be admitted to a course. Several aspects are taken into account to selecting a student, including:

Students are advised to check the information related to the respective to take admission. This can be done by purchasing the prospectus either online or offline. After initial registration, a student is required to pay the complete fee within one week of registration or one week after the announcement of final results. reviews.review_heading: Good placement, AI-driven.

The food is too good. We always enjoy having it with our friends. Even this campus includes a dispensary for medical issues, and a lot of sports activities are organised by the clubs.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with the facilities. Only issue is that they ask for fee time to time.

reviews.review_heading: Positive environment with hygienic surroundings.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, college is very good and supportive. Placements are very good.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, the college is good and still improving.

reviews.review_heading: Overall experience is good teachers and understanding and helpful.

reviews.review_heading: It has really good teaching staff members.

admission_process.title: CMRCET Hyderabad Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: CMR College of Engineering and Technology admissionsare entrance-based. The college selects candidates based onEAMCET,GATEandICETscores for admission to specific programmes.CMRCEToffers admissions under Convener and Management Quota. The college offers courses at UG and PG levels in the Engineering and Management streams in affiliation withJNTUH.

The college offers admission to the offered programmes based on the entrance exam scores of the candidates. The minimum eligibility to apply for UG courses is Class 12, whereas graduation is required for PG programmes. Find belowCMRCET Hyderabad coursesalong with their eligibility and selection criteria:

CMR College of Engineering and Technology admissions begin with accepted exam registration. Candidates need to appear for any of the accepted entrance tests for admission. Below are the steps to get a seat in the college:
Step 1: CMRCET Application Process 2025

Candidates need to fill out the application form for the accepted entrance exam. Aspirants can apply online for TS ICET, TS PGECET, and others as required by the applied course. Candidates need to pay an application fee to register for the test. In case of any query, aspirants can fill out the admission enquiry form.
Step 2: Selection

Admission to 70% seats (Convener Quota) of BTech is based on TS EAMCET scores. 30% seats are available for Category-B (Management Quota) admission. Besides, aspirants are selected based on TS ECET scores for BTech (Lateral Entry) courses. For MBA and MTech courses, the college considers scores in TS ICET and GATE/ TS PGECET, respectively.
Step 3: Counselling & Seat Allotment

Aspirants need to register for the accepted entrance exam counselling. The seats are offered to candidates based on their rank through counselling rounds. Aspirants need to choose CMRCET as a preferred college while filling out the form. Once selected, aspirants need to report at the campus for document verification. Aspirants also need to pay theCMRCET feeto confirm their seat in the college.

The college offers BTech, MTech and MBA courses at UG and PG levels.CMR Technical Campus (Autonomous Engineering College)conducts an online mode of application for all the courses. To get admission, candidates are required to fulfil the criteria set by the college. All the information related to CMR Technical Campus (Autonomous Engineering College) admission along with courses is available in the below article:

CMR Technical Campus (Autonomous Engineering College) courses admission is open. The institute offers BTech, MTech and MBA at the UG and PG levels. Admission to all the courses is entrance-based. However, the college also offers 30% of seats via management quota. Admission to the management quota is based on the last qualifying exam score. STEP 1: CMR Technical Campus (Autonomous Engineering College) Application Process 2025Candidates must fill out the CMR Technical Campus (Autonomous Engineering College) admission eligibility criteria and selection criteria for all courses. reviews_list.review_title: Before 2018-2019, our college was like an Autonomous College.

review_content.Placements: Only 10% of students are placed in our course. The lowest is 1.2 Lacs per annum, and the maximum is 1.7 Lacs per annum. Shree Cement & SPD Construction are the companies. No student got an internship. Junior Engineer & Site Engineer are the most preferred jobs available. This is the problem for everyone who is from a Tier 3 college. I am facing the same issue. The campus package is not more than 3 Lacs per annum. I was feeling very bad asking pass-out seniors about jobs. Then someone gave me a wise suggestion: He told me to find a good company, not a big company. Let me explain, I am a machine learning enthusiast, and he told me to find a startup that is working on data science and machine learning. Don’t worry about salary. It may be very less, but in that organization, you will get the best work experience. Your learning curve will be vertical. Believe me, you will see a wide difference in yourself after 1 year because in a startup, you have to work professionally on your own for a long time (1-1.5 years). After that, you can start applying for big corporates. Now your confidence and professional skills will help you to crack any interview. Don’t waste time or spend a year to find a high-paying job. Or else, if you have good enough skills that fulfill the requirements of big corporates, then definitely you can apply now.

individual_reviews.title: Work hard to achieve success.

content.Placements: 85% percent of students are placed in our course. The highest package is 100000, the lowest package is 50000, and the average package is 75000. Our course offers various placement packages, including companies like TCS. Additionally, 45 percent of students received internships. The top role available in our course is Manager.
content.Infrastructure: We have various facilities provided like Wi-Fi, labs, cinema halls, auditorium hall, swimming pool, park, garden, etc. Infrastructure like smart classrooms, AC, LEDs, smart libraries, lifts, and many more things are available in our college. All qualities are good.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Student review of College of Engineering, Bhubaneswar.

content.Placements: Placement percentage is above 70% in PCM. The highest package is of 20 Lacs per annum and the lowest is of 5 Lacs per annum. Top recruiters include Google, Amazon, etc. On campus placements are a bit hard to get due to huge number of students, so you can also try off campus just to be safe.
content.Infrastructure: There are many lab like Electronic, Electrical, Mechanical, Physics and Chemistry etc. Food quality of the hostel is not good. I did not like the food in hostels, but the rooms are great. Cleaning facilities are very good but time limit for outing is very less.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Before 2018-2019, our college was like an Autonomous College.

content.Placements: Only 10% of students are placed in our course. The lowest is 1.2 Lacs per annum, and the maximum is 1.7 Lacs per annum. Shree Cement & SPD Construction are the companies. No student got an internship. Junior Engineer & Site Engineer are the most preferred jobs available. This is the problem for everyone who is from a Tier 3 college. I am facing the same issue. The campus package is not more than 3 Lacs per annum. I was feeling very bad asking pass-out seniors about jobs. Then someone gave me a wise suggestion: He told me to find a good company, not a big company. Let me explain, I am a machine learning enthusiast, and he told me to find a startup that is working on data science and machine learning. Don’t worry about salary. It may be very less, but in that organization, you will get the best work experience. Your learning curve will be vertical. Believe me, you will see a wide difference in yourself after 1 year because in a startup, you have to work professionally on your own for a long time (1-1.5 years). After that, you can start applying for big corporates. Now your confidence and professional skills will help you to crack any interview. Don’t waste time or spend a year to find a high-paying job. Or else, if you have good enough skills that fulfill the requirements of big corporates, then definitely you can apply now.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Disappointed with finance

content.Placements: The placement rate is very low in our course and specially in our whole college, only 30-50%. Highest package was 4 LPA and lowest was 1.5 LPA. TCS, Wipro, HCL, Royal Enfield, OD Tech were the top recruiting companies. No one got internship from college. Mostly sales and few IT roles are offered.
content.Infrastructure: We have got simple classroom with no projectors whereas there are projectors for MCA and b-tech. We have got access to library, computer labs and access to various clubs in our college. Food is average, no medical facility in college, multiple clubs are there.

content.Faculty: All teachers are helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable. They teach us fluently, so we can understand easily. This course curriculum is relevant. It makes students industry-ready. Semester exams are not much difficult in our college.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied because of faculty members, good placements, good infrastructure, facilities, etc.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with its teachers, infrastructure, and good placements are there for 2021 and 2022.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is one of the best engineering colleges. I recommend students to study here.

It has a basketball court and a badminton court, and also has a cricket ground in which the pitch is made up of cement. Every year the college make an annual function but from previous 6 years, and the college is not arranging it.

reviews.review_heading: I think our college is the best for placements. I am satisfied with it.
reviews.review_text: Labs and the hostels are great. In the hostels, you will surely have lots of fun with friends. The food system is the best in the college. reviews.review_heading: I'm satisfied with the placements and infrastructure of the campus. The teaching is good.

They give you the choice of choosing rooms, and if you want a room with an attached bathroom, the cost is more. Our hostel has a well-maintained gym.

reviews.review_heading: In this college, you will love to join, study and have a wonderful experience.
reviews.review_text: Our campus is completely Wi-Fi enabled. Labs are well operated with one computer to one student. There are centrally air-conditioned labs. Classrooms are old fashioned, but have huge space and are well ventilated. The library is accessible every day. The hostel is very good actually, and it is also completely Wi-Fi enabled. The food served here is nice.

reviews.review_heading: Decent placements offered.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, laboratory, Library, Gym, Sports area like facilities are available in our campus. Talking about the food quality, ne must say it is below average. The canteen facility is good. The medical and sports facilities are decent. This is not a sports centric institute. If you are looking for a sports centric institute, then this is not for you.

faqs.question: What is the frequency of the Karnataka PGCET exam?

reviews.review_heading: Overall good college with supportive faculty, good campus life. Sports facilities aren't great.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of my college is good, and it has one of the biggest campuses in Bangalore, but the hostel is overpriced. Coming to food, the mess isn't that good, and the quality doesn't match the price we are paying. Labs are conducted every week and have Ethernet LAN connections. The college library is good and has Wi-Fi as well, so you can come and study anytime. Borrowing books from there requires a card.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with the college, but I wanted some more good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are good. The infrastructure is old, and it's a very old building. Some classrooms are in very bad conditions, but nowadays, they are working on problems and sorting them out. I do not stay in a hostel, but a few of my friends say that's good compared to any other college. There are two hotels in our college, one is the NRI hostel, which has a good infrastructure and good room space, but the con is that they don't have proper food facilities. The other is an Indian hostel, which has g...

reviews.review_heading: Honest review of my college.
reviews.review_text: Hostels are decent. I do not go to a hostel because I am a day scholar, college infrastructure is good and well maintained. Rules are strict though. A hostel is available for males and females. Mess food when heard by students its bad just average, classrooms are decent below average.

reviews.review_heading: It's good for CSE, I would say, and if you need a good campus life, then also it's good to join.
reviews.review_text: The college campus is really good, and the infrastructure is also good. It has all facilities like labs, Wi-Fi, canteen, and on-campus hostel. The food in the mess is not good, as I have heard, that the food in the canteen, is the food good;, it's like average. Some dishes are good, and some are not.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Dayanand Sagar College of Engineering.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available for our course are extremely good. Wi-Fi facility is available. Labs are well-equipped with instruments and machinery. There are modern computer labs. VLSI lab is also present. Hostel quality is also good. All essential facilities are available.

reviews.review_heading: College is amazing due to its extracurricular activities and amazing coding clubs at a high rate.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very good. It is just like a new techno park. The hostel food and living are also good. It feels more like home to me. The hostel timings are quite amazing on the campus. Hostel guards are quite friendly and helpful to everyone.

reviews.review_heading: Dayananda Sagar College of Engineering is good for placements.
reviews.review_text: In Dayananda Sagar College of Engineering, they have good facilities, and all courses are available. The hostel infrastructure is good, and food is provided in the hostel mess. The fee for the hostel is around Rs. 2,00,000. Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and a library are available in this college.

reviews.review_heading: It is an old college and good for placements.
reviews.review_text: The hostel infrastructure is good at the same college, too. They conduct games between courses and also provide gifts for winning. Conducted games like cricket, kabaddi, volleyball, choo-choo, and throw ball. They have commitments to conduct events, functions, etc.

reviews.review_heading: COMEDK people will not be satisfied because they pay a high fee.
reviews.review_text: I can say that classrooms infrastructure is average. Labs are good with AC facility. Coming to hostel, I want to give minus (the worst) but they collect more fees that too it is also in the name of trust. Food is also not upto to the fee we pay. I only stayed there for one year and shifted to PG.

reviews.review_heading: The college is amazing. It has a good campus and good placements. Everything is amazing.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good. Our college has labs, classrooms, Wi-Fi, and digital boards. The quality of faculty in my hostel is very good. The food is amazing. It has a hospital on the campus. Every kind of sport and game is available.

reviews.review_heading: Finally, I conclude it is worth to join.
reviews.review_text: We have good campus with a big garden. I like a hill we have to climb a hill daily. If you want to join our college, we have a rock garden. Good sophisticated library with all facilities, a wide variety of books from school to master's degree, all of them in a bite.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with college, good placements in ECE department, and fee is little bit higher side.
reviews.review_text: Labs in ECE blocks are well-equipped with all the required instruments, classrooms are spacious and well-ventilated. DSCE campus has two hostels NRI and Indian hostels. Food is served four times a day with well-maintained hygiene in mess. Library of DSCE is one of the biggest libraries in Bangalore. All books are available for your interest. Sports and gym facilities are there at the college.

reviews.review_heading: All about Dayananda Sagar College of Engineering.
reviews.review_text: The hostel is very old and not well maintained for the fee they are collecting from students. It is old and not worth the whooping fee of 180,000 per year. The food is also very bad according to my friends who stay there. It is better to choose a PG near the campus, as they are cheaper and student-friendly.

reviews.review_heading: Dissatisfied a lot because of the faculty.
reviews.review_text: Labs have old equipment. Some don't work properly. Even the computers are out of date. Some classrooms don't have proper ventilation. Fans though present, don't work that well. Hostel is quite expensive so many prefer staying in PGs. Hostel Food is decent.

reviews.review_heading: Good college with good facilities.
reviews.review_text: It's a good infrastructure with all the facilities like smart classes. All the equipments in labs are available. It is not a big college. It has only 28 acres of land. You will get many food shops nearby but you won't get any sports opportunities here. There is only one ground.

paragraphs: To get into Dhirubhai Ambani University (formerly DA-IICT) Students must follow the admission procedure as per the Institute's guidelines.
1: Dhirubhai Ambani University (formerly DA-IICT) Gandhinagar Application Process 2026

The mode of application is online for all courses. Students must visit the Dhirubhai Ambani University (formerly DA-IICT)'s official website and first of all register themselves on the institute's official website. After registration, Students can access the online application form. The applicants must fill out the online application form with all the required details. Aspirants need to pay an application fee.
2: Selection Rounds

Dhirubhai Ambani University (formerly DA-IICT) shortlists Students based on GATE, JEE Mains, or other entrance tests for a few courses. For BTech and MTech, Students are selected based on the JEE Main/GATE scores. For MDes CEED is considered for selection and MSc shortlisting is done based on the entrance test. The institute releases a list after the selection rounds to announce the names of shortlisted Students.
3: Admission Confirmation/ Counselling

A provisional admission notice is sent to Students shortlisted based on merit. Aspirants who have appeared for the entrance exam are called for counselling. Students need to pay a course fee to confirm their seat in the institute.

Dhirubhai Ambani University (formerly DA-IICT) fees 2025 range from2 L to 5 L. Students who accept the admission offers must pay the course-wise admission fee to finalise their admission. A few selective courses also accept counselling and personal interview. Gujarat-based candidates are given different weightage during the selection process. Admission to Dhirubhai Ambani Institute of Information & Communication Technology, or DAIICT, is entirely entrance-based.DAIICToffers UG, PG and PhD programmes such as BTech, MTech, MSc, MDes, and PhD under various disciplines.

hostel_campus.college_name: Dhirubhai Ambani University (formerly DA-IICT) Infrastructure Details & Reviews

hostel.description: Dhirubhai Ambani Institute of Information and Communication Technology has two halls of residence, one for men and the other for women. The rooms are furnished with a bed, table, chair and a cupboard for each occupant. For students using their own computers in the room, internet facility is provided at a very nominal per semester charge. Hot water (using solar panels), Laundry and TV Rooms with Dish TV are available in both halls of residence. Residence at the Halls is compulsory for all B.Tech. students.

library.description: The library of DAIICT connects the user to its relevant information resources. It has a rich and diverse collection of about 31020 books, 11230 e-books, 5674  e-journals, 78 print journals, 10 databases, 663 theses and 3913 audiovisual material in the ICT, social science, and humanities. This collection can be searched by a web-enabled online catalog. The students can also browse and access the various electronic resources such as e-journals, e-books, and databases using the dedicated terminals in the reading zones. The library has resource sharing a collaboration with Information and Library Network (INFLIBNET) and National Digital Library of India (NDLI).

sports.description: Available Facilities: Badminton Court, Basketball Court, Cricket Ground, Football Ground, Volleyball Court, Table Tennis
