reviews.review_heading: Strong academics and placements with a rigorous curriculum and good campus facilities.
reviews.review_text: Campus overview includes classrooms and lecture spaces, library/resource centre, and laboratories. Facilities provide high-speed Wi-Fi/LAN in rooms. Hot water, laundry services, TV rooms, and basic utilities are available. Common washrooms are provided and are not usually attached. Security and maintenance services are available on campus. Sports facilities include cricket ground, volleyball, football, basketball, and badminton courts. A gym for fitness, yoga space, and music rooms are available...

reviews.review_heading: College tour of DAIICT by a first semester guy.
reviews.review_text: The mess is just compulsory for the first year as of now. The food at the mess is not that great, sports are good, though you have to bring your own equipment, and there are medical facilities available throughout the year. There is Wi-Fi for all students with a limit of 20 GB a day.

reviews.review_heading: Good environment. Good college structure. Around 18 LPA is the average package.
reviews.review_text: Good infrastructure. Non-AC classrooms. Laboratory buildings have AC and are open 24/7. Library is really good. Hostel is also good. Two-sharing and three-sharing rooms are available. Eco-friendly campus. There are so many birds. But sometimes monkeys come into hostel.

reviews.review_heading: I think our college is very good, especially for our course.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, all types of labs, classrooms, a library and many facilities are on our campus, and these things are very good. Hostels are also good. There is a mess and a canteen for first-year students, the mess is compulsory after completion of the first year. You have a choice if you want to eat in a mess, you can, and canteens are always open. The mess has an average quality of food, while the canteen has good quality food. Medical facilities will be provided by the college, and they are good. It h...

reviews.review_heading: Where teach dreams meet top-tier placements.
reviews.review_text: This college has 50 acres of area in total with well-maintained lawns, a garden, and open space. Equipped with smart classrooms, seminar halls, and lecture theatres with modern audio-visual facilities. Boys and girls have different hostel blocks with decent living conditions.

reviews.review_heading: It is a great place for good exposure. I have a great college experience.
reviews.review_text: It has good hostels. Labs and classrooms are well-equipped. The lecture theatre is good. A mess facility is available and mandatory for freshers. The canteen service is good. The annual sports fest is awesome.

reviews.review_heading: Engineering heaven of Gujarat.
reviews.review_text: Here, placements at DAIICT are very awesome. Although there is a lack of tech jobs. There are also 90% of placements. Companies are JP Morgan, Morgan Stanley, TCS, Reliance, and so on. If we want to go into such huge MNCs then of course take admission in DAIICT.

reviews.review_heading: Good enough to start here!
reviews.review_text: Hostel rooms, Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and the library are all good. Hostel rooms are non-AC, but Wi-Fi is really good. The canteen food is average, but around the college, there are lots of options to eat. Medical facilities are also good. The gym is not that great, and the game facilities are average.

reviews.review_heading: Really very good infrastructure and the placements are very good.
reviews.review_text: The facilities are excellent, like the best college in Gujarat. The hostels of DAIICT are amazing, and the ground is very big, giving a feel like we are in a real cricket ground. The medical facilities are also good; 2 or 3 doctors come from other hospitals.

reviews.review_heading: A state of the art infrastructure with average placement opportunity and a high fees.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure for the ICT course is top-notch. There are state-of-the-art lab facilities and a library containing around 30,000 books with a reading room that is open until 12 am, and for exam days, the timing is until 2 am. All the professors are well qualified and experts in their field.

reviews.review_heading: Value for money college.
reviews.review_text: The college has a very wide campus. The infrastructure of our college is well developed. The college has all the facilities, including Wi-Fi, canteen, mess, hostel, labs, library, swimming pool, medical facility, sports facility, etc. The college computer labs are working properly. The college also focuses on sports activities. There are all sports facilities available in our college.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Dhirubhai Ambani Institute of Information and Communication Technology.
reviews.review_text: At DAIICT, the hostel has two types of rooms: double occupancy and triple occupancy rooms. In every room for each student, there is a bed, a cupboard, a table, and a chair. It provides Wi-Fi facilities to students. There are 5 canteens. You can choose from where you want to buy. Overall, the food quality is good. Doctors visit our campus twice a day.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is good in terms of placements.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college and the hostel is good. Our college provides us with all the facilities. They provide sufficient facilities. The mess facility is not available in our college. We have many food courts where we can get anything at any time.

reviews.review_heading: Our college has excellent placements and a good hostel.
reviews.review_text: The hostel life is good. Our college provides good infrastructure. Sports activities are done very often. Mess facilities are not available.

reviews.review_heading: Our college has a perfect coding culture and competition.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides 24X7 Wi-Fi. Classrooms are huge and comfortable. There is a resource center in our college where we can read after study hours. It also has a library in it. There are many labs. They are in good condition with all equipment. There are canteens for vegetarian and non-vegetarian food items. They provide a variety of food items. There are grounds for football, cricket, volleyball, badminton, basketball, table tennis, etc. Our college has a gymnasium. It is in perfect condition....

paragraphs: GH Raisoni College Nagpur admissions 2025is entrance-based for all courses. The college offers BTech, MTech, and MBA courses at the UG and PG level. Apart from the UG and PG courses the college also offers PhD courses. To get admitted to RCN, candidates must meet the eligibility criteria set by the college. The application process atGH Raisoni College Nagpuris conducted online. Read the article to know more aboutGH Raisoni College Nagpur course admission2025.

GH Raisoni College Nagpur admission 2025is completely entrance-based. The college offers courses in three streams, i.e., Business & Management Studies, Engineering and IT & Software. The mode of study of the programme is full-time. The basic eligibility for UG courses is Class 12 whereas, graduation is required to apply for PG programmes. GH Raisoni College Nagpur admissionsare primarily entrance-based. Candidates can register online for admission to their preferred course. The admission process at GH Raisoni College Nagpur is as per the steps below:
STEP 1: GH Raisoni College Nagpur Application Process 2025

The application mode is online. For admission to the various UG programmes, aspirants need to apply at the official website, https://raisoni.nopaperforms.com/rgi. Candidates can fill out the application form on the institute's official website.
STEP 2: Selection

The college considers various entrance exam scores such as JEE Main, GATE, MHTCET MTech, etc for admission to the BTech, MTech among courses. It also considers the candidates' academic performance for final selection.
STEP 3: Merit List & Admission Confirmation

The college also releases a merit list based on the composite score of the candidates for admission. Shortlisted aspirants need to come for document verification and pay theGH Raisoni College Nagpur feeto confirm their seats at the college.

The hostel mess, I can say, in the beginning, they provide very tasty food, but after some time, the quality is not so good, but a student can manage it.

reviews.review_heading: The placement and infrastructure are good.
reviews.review_text: Hostel facilities are good. Infrastructure is also good. There is a huge playground in which we can play cricket, tennis, and football. The water facility is good. Room quality is decent, and the fees at the hostel are also decent. Management is a little bit poor but decent.

reviews.review_heading: Galgotias College brutal honest review.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good. The campus is a bit small but cute. Clean and greenery are there. In classrooms, digital boards are installed with ACs and Wi-Fi connections. We have a separate library block, and a variety of books are available. There is also an online virtual system of library resources provided by our college. In hostels, Wi-Fi is available. Proper beds, desks, and facilities, like a gym and a common room, are provided. Mess food is average and provided by the Sodexo company. Meals ar...

reviews.review_heading: Good college with good placement and campus life.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are smart with digital boards and fully Air conditioning. Labs are also very good, they are renovated a few years ago with highly equipped and all equipments. The library is also very good. Hostel have all facilities like a gym, good food and a big room.

reviews.review_heading: What galgotias offers and what it doesn't.
reviews.review_text: There is Wi-Fi in almost every 3-4 classrooms on each floor. Labs have every necessary working equipment, and there are smartboards in every class. The library is massive, with a 350 seating capacity and a huge collection of books for knowledge in any field.

reviews.review_heading: My experience at Galgotias College of Engineering and Technology.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are equipped with smartboards and Wi-Fi. It makes learning easy and understandable. The library offers a huge collection of books, journals, and resources. They provide students with an excellent learning environment. Overall, the experience is really good. The hostel is good. The building is quite old, but the rooms are manageable. Food is good, provided by Sodexo. The canteen, sports, and games facilities are very good.

reviews.review_heading: In 460,000, you can get an average salary package of 5 LPA, so it is a pretty decent college.
reviews.review_text: Our college labs are quite good, with i7 computers, and Wi-Fi is also good. The classrooms are of new modern architecture, and hostel facilities are specifically good. The toilets are modern, and the mess food is excellent. I would say that despite having less space, my college is very good in the field of sports as well.

reviews.review_heading: Campus life is very good and one of the best colleges in terms of infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available in every class, classrooms have air conditioning, labs are modern with all required equipment, the huge library provides a good environment and many books, sports facilities are available for athletes, the canteen is average but good, and one block is reserved for medical emergencies.

reviews.review_heading: Really, GCET is a value-for-money college with affordable fees and good placements.
reviews.review_text: I'm a Data Science branch student, which is separate from the Computer Science department. Infrastructure is all good, having proper ground, court and equipment for Volleyball, basketball, table tennis, cricket and badminton. Food is average, but there are many canteens on the campus. The library is best as advanced computers are available.

reviews.review_heading: I think the best reasonable college for B. Tech in CSE that gives the best ROI.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good, but campus is decent, not too big like 18 acres you get, and best given laboratory according to your branch. Like I have the CSE core branch, so we get the best labs in the college for our classes in the CSE department. Mess is decent, but food quality and menu is awesome as I think it gives the best food in comparison to other private hostels and PG food.

reviews.review_heading: It has great infrastructure, positive experience, satisfying placement, and growth opportunities.
reviews.review_text: The campus is spread across 15-18 acres of land with a modern look and well-planned buildings. Classrooms are spacious. Wi-Fi facilities work well. Labs are updated to support practical learning. The grounds are large. Sports facilities are good, which adds a positive environment to campus life. The experience has been good in terms of available space, maintenance, and college atmosphere.

reviews.review_heading: Greater Noida's best college of AKTU.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure of our college are great. It is a fully Wi-Fi campus, and the classrooms are digital. The library is too small but okay. Hostel facilities are good, and the mess food is hygienic, though less in taste, but okay for eating. The canteen, medical facilities, and sports are also available.

reviews.review_heading: College is good. The cafe area is good.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is awesome. The hostel is good. I am currently in a hostel. There is no problem. GCET has a clean and well-maintained campus. Classrooms, labs, and libraries are good and updated. The sports area and common space are decent. Overall, the infrastructure is solid and supports academics well.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and 2 sports grounds here. And the faculty is too supportive.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is too good, like 13 to 14 acres approximately. And I enjoyed my college life.

reviews.review_heading: Good campus with supportive faculty and decent placement.
reviews.review_text: The college provides good facilities like high-speed Wi-Fi, projectors, classrooms, computer labs, and a well-maintained library. Hostel rooms are decent and clean. Mess food quality is average but hygienic. Medical facilities and sports grounds are available on campus.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: The institute is good, but in order to get a good placement, we have work very hard.

content.Placements: Placements are good, but we need to work hard to get good placements. It means if students can work hard for their success, then they definitely can get a good placement here. If students want to enjoy, then they can expect a placement here. Hard work is required.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is good. Buildings and hostels are a little old. But now they are upgrading everything, so there are no issues about infrastructure. The environment around here is cool and pleasant. Nature gives us a good feel.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Overall, placements are for skilled students in GIET University.

content.Placements: 60 percent of students are getting more than a 5 LPA package, and the rest are getting an average of 3.5 LPA. From our branch, Computer Engineering placements are for students who have 7 CGPA and above and maintain 90 percent attendance in the TNP classes. The rest of the students are getting free internships.
content.Infrastructure: College Wi-Fi is available and is very high-speed, but it has limited data for each student. The library is very big, has a huge number of books, and is open 24 hours. Hostel facilities are not that good. Wi-Fi is not available in the hostel, and mobile data speed is also slow, even for Airtel. The quality of food is average. Medical facilities are available, but they are sometimes open and mostly closed.

Many students get internships in new startups, and not in highly rated companies.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Really good for placement, GIETU.

These programmes are offered in several fields, such as Engineering, Technology, Social Work, Science, Science, Computer Applications, etc. Interested students can read the following article to learn more about the courses, eligibility, selection criteria, and admission procedure for GIET University.

To get admission into the GIET University, students are required to complete the course-specific admission criteria. The admission process mainly commences online. Students need to apply for the desired course, followed by the selection process and admission confirmation. Interested students can follow the steps mentioned below to complete theGIET University admission process:
Step 1: GIET Gunupur University Application Process
The admission process starts with filling out the GIET Gunupur application form. Interested candidates can visit the official website of GIET University to apply for the course of their choice.
Step 2: GIET Gunupur University Selection Process

The university conducts its exams like GIETEE for BTech, BCA, BSc, MTech, and MCA courses. The university also accepts national-based entrance exams, such as CMAT/ MAT/ CAT/ XAT/ OJEE scores for the MBA programme.
Step 3: GIET Gunupur University Admission Confirmation
After completion of the selection rounds, the shortlisted candidates are called for verification of the documents. Aspirants need to pay a course fee to confirm their seat in the university.

reviews.review_heading: The institute is good, but in order to get a good placement, we have work very hard.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good. Buildings and hostels are a little old. But now they are upgrading everything, so there are no issues about infrastructure. The environment around here is cool and pleasant. Nature gives us a good feel.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, placements are for skilled students in GIET University.
reviews.review_text: College Wi-Fi is available and is very high-speed, but it has limited data for each student. The library is very big, has a huge number of books, and is open 24 hours. Hostel facilities are not that good. Wi-Fi is not available in the hostel, and mobile data speed is also slow, even for Airtel. The quality of food is average. Medical facilities are available, but they are sometimes open and mostly closed.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and big crowd environment in this college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good because the campus is very big, and this university is located in the middle of mountains. Hostel facilities are manageable. Sports and medical facilities are available. Labs and classrooms are really good and equipped with Wi-Fi. Mess food is not good, as we are investing a lot of money.

reviews.review_heading: There is more focus on theoretical knowledge.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the departments is well-structured and well-maintained. Unlimited Wi-Fi access is available in all department buildings and the library. In the hostel, Wi-Fi usage is restricted to only 2 GB per day. In a mess, a well-structured routine of food is given.

reviews.review_heading: Really good for placement, GIETU.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure and the facilities are good. Our college course is well decorated and has free Wi-Fi and a library available for studies. The lab class is available with all equipment. Hostel facilities are also good. Mess food is hygienic, and it is adjustable for eating. Medical and sports facilities are also excellent.

reviews.review_heading: GIET University placement scenario.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our course is excellent. The facilities are also good. The course is well decorated with all the equipment. Free Wi-Fi is available, and labs and a library are available. The hostel is available for both boys and girls. Mess food is acceptable. Medical and sports facilities are also good.

reviews.review_heading: It is an amazing university to study at.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of this university is excellent and attractive. It is well-organised. The lab facility and classrooms are well-organised. Here, we have a better 24-hour free Wi-Fi facility. A specialised experiential area is there for our project management activities.

reviews.review_heading: GIET University is the best private university. It provides good knowledge and experience.
reviews.review_text: Facilities in our department are good. Wi-Fi is available in the whole campus, including the lab and classrooms. In the library, almost all books are available, and it is always open for students. The quality of the food in the mess and canteen is good. Medical facilities are also available.

reviews.review_heading: Faculty members and the management of the course are good.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is so beautiful. There are all facilities in labs and classrooms like Wi-Fi, smart boards, projectors, and speakers. Most labs have an AC setup. In the library, AC is present, and it is open 24 hours for everyone. Medical facilities are very good. Sports ground is available.

reviews.review_heading: It provided good placements last year.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure of our course are average. Wi-Fi facility is available, but with a daily limit of 2 GB. Labs and classrooms are available with projectors and smart boards. The food quality of the hostel is bad because the same food is repeated every day. The taste of the food is good.

reviews.review_heading: It has bad faculty members. Placements are not even good.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is good. The condition of classrooms and labs is average. Every classroom and lab has Wi-Fi, but most of them are not working. Hostel facilities are good, and some VIP hostels are recommended as they have air conditioning.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and good placements are available at GIET University.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our department is big and well-designed. The infrastructure of the hostel is not much better. Our hostel provides Wi-Fi with a daily limit of 2 GB, but the speed of the Wi-Fi is very slow. In some classrooms, there is no Wi-Fi network, but the Wi-Fi network is available in labs.

reviews.review_heading: Excellent university to study .
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of this university is excellent. The classroom facility is also well organised. There is also available of central library. The Wi-Fi facility is also available for free to access. The hostel accommodation also provides excellent in campus for boys and in outside for girls. The sports facility is also available.

reviews.review_heading: Amazing 3-tier college to excel in engineering.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of this university is attractive for its beautiful building with a mountain view. The inside classroom facilities are acceptable. The lab facilities are also acceptable. There are 24 hours of free Wi-Fi available on campus, and each department has its own Wi-Fi. The hostel food is just mean, acceptable, not very good.

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: In labs, unlimited free Wi-Fi is provided. Our library has a well-defined infrastructure and central AC for students. In our university, Wi-Fi is available everywhere, and in our hostel, 2 GB per day free Wi-Fi is available. Those who want to study in the library can go there at any time for studies.

reviews.review_heading: Genuine review of GIET college.
reviews.review_text: Cultural activities were good in the college. When it comes to the hostel, the food was average, and the infrastructure was good. The classrooms, library, and canteen were very near the blocks and good. They allow sports in cultural activities only, but not for the leisure period in college.

reviews.review_heading: I am fully satisfied because of the faculty.
reviews.review_text: The college has diverse courses with good facilities like labs, a library, and sports, on a large green campus. Its hostels provide basic furniture (bed, table, cupboard) with options for AC/non-AC, Wi-Fi. There are separate messes, though the food quality receives mixed reviews, emphasising affordability and central location.

reviews.review_heading: The infrastructure is beautiful, and the faculty is student-friendly.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and their infrastructure of our course are beautiful and more attractive, and the Wi-Fi signal is good. The labs have excellent equipment, and the classrooms are clean and good. The libraries are filled with knowledge books and technology books, and the games and sports are conducted by the college management.

reviews.review_heading: It is really good to join because of the friendly faculty.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure are good and attractive. The Wi-Fi signal is really fast and good. The labs have good equipment, and the classrooms are clean and neat. Every class has digital boards, and the libraries are filled with technology books and knowledge books. The facilities of the hostel are really good and peaceful for students, and the quality of food in the hostel is really good and tasty. The medical facilities are really great, and the sports and games are organized by our col...

reviews.review_heading: The college environment was really good and the faculty was student friendly.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure are really good and excellent and more attractive to see and the facilities are too good. The Wi-Fi signal is good and the labs have good equipment and the library feel with lot of knowledge books and technology books. Food availability in the mess is too good and tasty and medical facilities are really excellent and take care of students. The main thing that college management encourages the students for sports and games.

reviews.review_heading: Faculty and infrastructure are good.
reviews.review_text: All facilities are available. The library is available at our college. The hostel is good, but the food served is not good. The canteen and medical facilities are available. There are separate boys’ hostel and girls’ hostel. Sports are not available on campus.

reviews.review_heading: Faculty and infrastructure are good.
reviews.review_text: The campus is wonderful with a vast amount of space and greenery, well-built infrastructure, and a Wi-Fi-surrounded campus. The library is technologically advanced, provided with systems with the internet along with books. The quality of food in the college hostel is decent with a healthy menu. In adequate times, sports are conducted mainly in festive seasons.

reviews.review_heading: I hope it improves for next year's students.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure are not so good, and not so bad. It is average. Classroom infrastructure is good. The college has two libraries that provide textbooks. There are canteens, and mess food is good. Sports facilities are available.

reviews.review_heading: A review of my college about the courses, placements, and cultural events.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the campus is very neat and good. They design the curriculum according to the respective departments to enhance student productivity. They provide hostels with different types of rooms for both Indian and international students.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely dissatisfied with placements in 2025 and faculty.
reviews.review_text: The Wi-Fi speed is not very fast. In the hostel, there are only two routers per floor. There is no Wi-Fi in classrooms. The overall infrastructure is better compared to other colleges. The hostel food is not very good.

reviews.review_heading: It will become a university in 2025, and it is attracting companies to hire the students.
reviews.review_text: The facilities are very good, it has a greenery college and it is very pleasant, full of trees. Wi-Fi facilities are also available, and labs are very attractive to get interested in doing work. Classrooms are very good and the library contains lots of programming and core subjects books which can be used to score marks and crack interviews.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Godavari Institute of Engineering and Technology.
reviews.review_text: The facilities are good, not bad, but the food quality in the hostel is not good. The mess food is acceptable, and the infrastructure is good, but the hostel rooms are not very good. The library is centrally air-conditioned, and the Wi-Fi signal is okay. The quality of food is not too good in this college, and medical facilities are available 24/7, with a hospital very near the college.

reviews.review_heading: Not good and not bad depends up
reviews.review_text: 1st-year campus is nice, but the 2nd-year campus is not that good looking because of old boards, classrooms, and benches. When it comes to the electronics lab, some kits will work, some won't, but the faculty will teach you how to do it with that kit.

reviews.review_heading: Godavari Institute of Engineering and Technology
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure in my course/department are above average. Classes are good and the lab is well-equipped. The library spans almost two floors, and we can see one canteen per block. Every working alternative day has one sports period.

reviews.review_heading: I am totally disappointed with this college regarding placements, infrastructure, and facilities.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is also too poor. When you start from labs to washrooms, nothing is in a proper way. Especially in our course, there is no proper laboratory equipment for study. I had asked my friends about the food in the mess, and they said it is below average.

review_summary.college_name: GJUST Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Facilities are average, like infrastructure, campus life, crowd, teachers, and hostel.

content.Placements: The highest package from CSE is 6 LPA, and the average package is around 3 LPA. 5-10 students are generally placed till now (mid placement season). Most of the students try to find internships off campus by building their skills on their own, and mostly get their placements off campus.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, library are good. There are all the facilities for a studious student who genuinely wants to study. But the hostel provided for B.Tech students is very bad. No space in the room, no separate almirah, table, chair, or even bed. The food is also very bad at this hostel.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Physiotherapy (BPT) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely dissatisfied because of the infrastructure. The faculty is supportive and caring.

content.Placements: No placements are available in my course at my college. But it gives placements in internships, which are very few. They are given to about 2-3 students in a full batch only, which is a very bad thing. I am absolutely dissatisfied with it, and it should give placements for jobs also.
content.Infrastructure: Benches in classrooms are bad and broken. Fans are not working properly. Hostels are average, and the food is average. The good thing about the college is that it has a very large sports complex, which has many indoor game courts and outdoor sports as well. There is a good library which is very large, and seats are available in very good condition.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Computer Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Review from 2nd sem B.Tech E&C student.

content.Placements: The placements are even less than what we call decent here. You cant expect more from the on campus placements from this college. They roam around 3 to 4 LPA as the average package. Of course, it depends on the crowd as well, but still, there are very few packages offered here.
content.Infrastructure: The hostels of the university are in a way like, like you get a hostel in just 1st year, after that, there will be no hostels facility for students and still the hostels are not that good. 4 to5 students live in a single room and it becomes impossible for someone to study.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: GJU, Hisar, college life review.

content.Placements: In our university, almost 50 percent of the students are placed on the campus. The average package is 4 LPA, and the highest package is 23 LPA. Some of the companies that are enrolled in our university are Wipro, Infosys, TVS, etc. Data scientist, data analytics, and AI engineering are the top courses seen in placement and internship.
content.Infrastructure: There is very good infrastructure that helps us to learn easily. Very good classrooms and smart classes with Wi-Fi for each student are provided in the hostel. The food quality is not very good, but it has good medical facilities and a good sports ground.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Packaging Technology - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: A great place for practical learning in printing & packaging.

content.Placements: Placements in the printing & packaging technology course are decent but still improving. Around 60-70% students get placed every year. Top recruiting companies include ITC, Parksons Packaging, Zircon, TCPL, and Natraj. The highest package goes around 7-8 LPA, the average is around 3-4 LPA, and the lowest can be 2-2.5 LPA. Many students also get internships in corrugation, label printing and flexible packaging companies, which helps in gaining industry exposure. More core printing companies are expected to come in future.
content.Infrastructure: The university has a large campus with greenery and well-maintained buildings. The printing department is equipped with modern labs, offset and flexographic printing machines, computer labs, and a good library. Wi-Fi is available, and classrooms are clean and spacious. Hostel facilities are good, rooms are maintained properly, and the mess food is average but hygienic. Sports facilities, medical centre, canteen and stationery shops are available on campus.

paragraphs: GJUST admission processbegins with registration for the course of their choice. The selection will be entrance-based for most of the programme. Check below step-wise GJUST admission process:
1. Application Process
Eligible students can apply online. You need to pay application fee to complete the process.
2. Selection

Once the candidates have applied for the course of their choice, their applications are evaluated. The selection for most of the programmes such as BA, MA, MBA, etc. is based onGJUST Entrance Test. National-level entrance exams are also accepted for admission such asJEE Main for BTechandCAT for MBA.For others, merit in the last qualifying exam is considered for admission.
3. Counselling and Seat Allotment

Once the selection rounds are over, shortlisted candidates are called for counselling. BTech candidates have to appear for HSTES Counselling. Aspirants are required to lock their preferences. The list of seat allotment will be available on the official website of the university. Selected candidates need to pay programme fee to confirm their seat in the university.

reviews_list.review_title: Average campus. Placements are excellent for technology & core branches, but average for CS and IT.

review_content.Placements: The placement for core and technology branches is excellent. No college of this rank can compete with it. This college is a savior for students with ranks below 60,000- 65,000. For CS/IT, the placement is average. If you are in the top 50%–60% of your class, you will get a minimum placement of 8–9 LPA, a maximum of 18 LPA or more, and the lowest around 3–6 LPA. Most students get jobs as the placement rate is above 90%.
review_content.Infrastructure: Currently, IT does not have its own department. First-year classes are held in the lecture hall complex. While second- and third-year classes are in the main building. Classroom infrastructure is average, with some air-conditioned rooms. Fourth-year classes are held in the Computer Science department, whose infrastructure is below average. A new extension for the CS department is being built, which will also accommodate IT students. Overall, the college infrastructure is average, similar to most state government universities.

review_summary.college_name: HBTU Kanpur Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Chemical Technology (Oil Technology) - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Oil Technology don't include mineral oils and gases in HBTU.

content.Placements: HBTU holds a 100 percent placement record in the oil branch, with many of the students receiving more than one offer. The highest placement this year is 14 LPA, with an average package of 8 LPA, and the lowest is 4 LPA. The top recruiting companies include Ruchi Soya (under Patanjali), ExxonMobil, Reliance, and others. Almost 30 percent of the students in the 3rd year got internships, and almost 20 percent from the 2nd year in 2025. Apart from this, students from the 3rd and 4th years also perform research in the field of oil. The roles of oil technologists are offered.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: College is very good and has a powerful alumni network.

content.Placements: As of 2025, 59 students were eligible out of which 56 got placed in my branch in mechanical engineering. Placement percentage is 107%. Top recruitment companies are Samsung Electronics and TCS which often pick students in bulk. Almost 70% of students got internships from the campus.
content.Infrastructure: As we know, the college is very old thus the infrastructure is also very old but it gives chills too. The hostel is in bad condition. The mess food is below average for the first-year students. Water quality is bad as of now. Wi-Fi is available, which gives 8 GB per student per day but it is very slow.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information Technology - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Average campus. Placements are excellent for technology & core branches, but average for CS and IT.

content.Placements: The placement for core and technology branches is excellent. No college of this rank can compete with it. This college is a savior for students with ranks below 60,000- 65,000. For CS/IT, the placement is average. If you are in the top 50%–60% of your class, you will get a minimum placement of 8–9 LPA, a maximum of 18 LPA or more, and the lowest around 3–6 LPA. Most students get jobs as the placement rate is above 90%.
content.Infrastructure: Currently, IT does not have its own department. First-year classes are held in the lecture hall complex. While second- and third-year classes are in the main building. Classroom infrastructure is average, with some air-conditioned rooms. Fourth-year classes are held in the Computer Science department, whose infrastructure is below average. A new extension for the CS department is being built, which will also accommodate IT students. Overall, the college infrastructure is average, similar to most state government universities.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information Technology - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: My hbtu 3 years journey.

content.Placements: In my batch there are 80 students and almost all my senior classes have the same strength. Almost 90 percent students got placed and the package in my branch is around 11 LPA and the internship opportunities are very limited for CSE and Information Technology students.
content.Infrastructure: The boys hostel is not too satisfying in terms of cleaning and the infrastructure is also not too good but the greenery is good in the college. The campus is too big and the boys hostel provides very limited restriction so students can do many extracurricular activities.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: The college is decent best.

content.Placements: The core jobs are not very high because, if you are someone wanting to work in the core field, that will be quite difficult, as the company pattern shows that they hire more students from M.Tech. But if you learn coding through the four years of B.Tech, then the chances for placements are quite high, as you would have the choice of going to the IT sector and other software jobs.
content.Infrastructure: HBTU has two campuses: East Campus and West Campus. The East Campus has two boys’ hostels for first-year students and a girls’ hostel for each year. The West Campus has hostels only for boys of 2nd, 3rd, and final year, Shatabdi Bhavan for cultural events, a cricket ground, a gymnasium, and other facilities. However, the condition of the hostel rooms is not of a very high standard. The hostels accommodate single, double, and three-seater rooms.

After the conclusion of the application procedure, the cutoff list is released by the university. Hence, the seat allotment process is carried out based on the applicants NIMCET rank. To take this test, candidates need to register online on its official website. Moreover, candidates also need to register on the university official website for this course and submit the application successfully by paying the fee.

faqs.question: What is the HBTU NIMCET Cutoff 2024?
faqs.answer: TheHBTU NIMCET Cutoff 2024was released for admission to the MCA course. The cutoff was published for various categories under the All India quota.For the General AI category, the cutoff was26in round 1 and52in the last round. Please remember that the cutoff will vary for each category and round accordingly.

faqs.question: Who is eligible for MCA in HBTU?
faqs.answer: Candidates with a valid Bachelor's degree in Mathematics/Statistics/Engineering/Technology or having a BCA degree with a minimum of 60% aggregate (55% aggregate for SC/ST/PwD/OBC-NCL category) from a university recognised by UGC are eligible to apply. Applications of only the eligible candidates are acceptable. Moreover, applicants must hold the mark sheets and other documents during form filling and admission confirmation.

faqs.question: What are the courses offered by HBTU, Kanpur?
faqs.answer: Harcourt Butler Technical University provides 50+ courses across six streams at undergraduate, postgraduate and PhD levels. These courses are accredited by the National Board of Accreditation (NBA). The admissions to UG, PG, and PhD courses, namely MCA, MTech, MBA, BTech, PhD, and MSc are based on the entrance exam. All the courses at HBTU are offered under its five schools, namely the School of Engineering, School of Chemical Technology, School of Basic and Applied Sciences, School of Enterpreneurship and Management and School of Humanities and Social Sciences.

faqs.question: Can I get direct admission at HBTU Kanpur?
faqs.answer: HBTU Kanpur offers admission to most of the programmes based on entrance exam scores of the candidates. The university accepts scores in NIMCET, CUET, CAT, GATE, CUET-PG, etc. for admission to specific programmes. Aspirants also need to pass the GDPI round for MBA admission. Hence, direct admission is usually not possible at HBTU Kanpur.

reviews.review_heading: Oil Technology don't include mineral oils and gases in HBTU.
reviews.review_text: The college is equipped with Wi-Fi, advanced labs, and a vast library that has books that are almost 100 years old to the latest journals, research papers, and e-books. For oil, there are 3 labs (one for UG, one for PG, and one for advanced research and Ph.D.). The lab has some of the most advanced equipment in the field of oil, and even samples from IIT come to HBTU for testing in the field of oil. The campus has an infirmary for any medical issues, where a doctor is available 7 days a week, an...

reviews.review_heading: College is very good and has a powerful alumni network.
reviews.review_text: As we know, the college is very old thus the infrastructure is also very old but it gives chills too. The hostel is in bad condition. The mess food is below average for the first-year students. Water quality is bad as of now. Wi-Fi is available, which gives 8 GB per student per day but it is very slow.

reviews.review_heading: Average campus. Placements are excellent for technology & core branches, but average for CS and IT.
reviews.review_text: Currently, IT does not have its own department. First-year classes are held in the lecture hall complex. While second- and third-year classes are in the main building. Classroom infrastructure is average, with some air-conditioned rooms. Fourth-year classes are held in the Computer Science department, whose infrastructure is below average. A new extension for the CS department is being built, which will also accommodate IT students. Overall, the college infrastructure is average, similar to most...

reviews.review_heading: My hbtu 3  years journey.
reviews.review_text: The boys hostel is not too satisfying in terms of cleaning and the infrastructure is also not too good but the greenery is good in the college. The campus is too big and the boys hostel provides very limited restriction so students can do many extracurricular activities.

reviews.review_heading: The college is decent best.
reviews.review_text: HBTU has two campuses: East Campus and West Campus. The East Campus has two boys’ hostels for first-year students and a girls’ hostel for each year. The West Campus has hostels only for boys of 2nd, 3rd, and final year, Shatabdi Bhavan for cultural events, a cricket ground, a gymnasium, and other facilities. However, the condition of the hostel rooms is not of a very high standard. The hostels accommodate single, double, and three-seater rooms.

reviews.review_heading: The underrated college with a great scope of improvement and decent placement.
reviews.review_text: The classes are spacious and well-ventilated with ACs. The library is huge, with over 1 lakh books. HBTU also has multiple canteens across the campus, offering plenty of spots to explore and hang out, making the overall campus experience lively and enjoyable.

reviews.review_heading: College is good in academics and also in extracurricular activities.
reviews.review_text: Labs and classrooms are so good, while the campus is fine, and libraries are so good. About 1 lakh books are available in the college, which is a good facility in the hostel, and the seniors are very supportive in the college, so the academics are going smoothly.

reviews.review_heading: Good college like in placements, course, alumni network.
reviews.review_text: The campus life is not that much good as compared to other colleges, and the location of the college is also a negative side. Hostel life is good until unless you are in East campus (where all the academic and administrative buildings are present). According to me, it’s better to take private hostel than choosing West campus hostel like Ambedkar and Aryabhatt in 1st year.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely worthy to join this college as it has a nice network.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is good and present all over campus. Food is good, and we can decide the menu by talking to our mess secretary. We can also add or subtract food items from the menu if people agree with us. The canteen is average, as we get normal things like samosas and parathas.

reviews.review_heading: Chemical/CT at HBTU is worth it, strong academics and consistently solid placements.
reviews.review_text: The campus is decent but mostly old. Buildings are functional, not modern. Labs are mixed, some are updated, while some are outdated. The hostel is basic with average maintenance; rooms are simple, and the mess food is consistent. Overall, it is a workable environment, but don’t expect premium facilities.

reviews.review_heading: The best college in Uttar Pradesh after the IIT.
reviews.review_text: There are several facilities in the hostels. There are separate hostels for girls and boys, in which facilities of mess and very variety of food and cultural diversity are also seen. Many students in Kanpur are from Kanpur itself as it offers a very good rate of interest to students.

reviews.review_heading: Review of HBTU (one of the top state universities).
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of my department is quite old and needs renovation. Wi-Fi is available with good speed throughout the campus. If I talk about the library, it is well-maintained and you can get almost all books and journals from here. The quality of rooms in the hostel is average, and you'll get double and triply seated rooms in 1st,  2nd and 3rd year, while in the final year, you will get a personal single room for sure. The quality of the mess food is average, but it degrades as time passes.

reviews.review_heading: HBTU is a decent college with a long history and also good recognition in Uttar Pradesh.
reviews.review_text: Library in HBTU is very nice. Fully air-conditioned and have the best infrastructure. But the infrastructure of hostels on the East Campus is old. It needs yearly maintenance however, the West campus is a perfect example of good infrastructure. There are several auditoriums in college and multiple grounds for sports and physical activities.

reviews.review_heading: Choose this college if you are not getting good NITs and you are ready for the grind.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, labs and library are available, classrooms are average. Hostel is also average with all basic facilities, a mess, laundry, canteen, and basic equipments for sports. Infrastructure of both departmental and hostel building is average. Medical facilities are provided by a dispensary in college. Students also receive insurance cover from college supported by a company.

reviews.review_heading: Our infrastructure is improving day by day. Faculty members are really nice and help us.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure gets enhanced by our faculty members according to the requirements as new labs are designed for us to get into it deeper and understand the techniques used in biotechnology. We have a central library and classrooms with AC. Wi-Fi is provided all over the campus. My hostel is Vishwakarma, where facilities are really good. Canteen is also available for us. The quality of food is so good. On college campus medical facilities are also available.

college_info.intro:
The flagship programmes offered at Hindusthan College of Engineering and Technology include BTech and MBA. The college offers BE and BTech via the Department of Computer Science and Engineering. Students can pursue the BE/ BTech courses and secure a Bachelor's degree after completing four years in the course. The BE/BTech programme spans over eight semesters and covers 16 specialisations, including highly sought-after fields such as Mechanical Engineering (BE), Aeronautical Engineering (BE), Information Technology (BTech), Biomedical Engineering, etc.
Hindusthan College of Engineering and Technology MBA is a general degree programme offered full-time. The MBA curriculum is spread across four semesters summed up in two academic years. The college accepts TANCET exam scores for admission to the MBA course. Based on the entrance examination, the college will release a merit list of selected students to appear for the TANCET counselling process. courses_data.name: Hindusthan College of Engineering and Technology MCA Admissions 2025
courses_data.description: Hindusthan College of Engineering and Technology offers a two-yearMCAprogramme at the PG level. MCA admission to all the courses is subject to a valid score in the national/state-level entrance exam along with the fulfilment of the minimum eligibility criteria set by the college. Students must have passed graduation in the relevant field from a recognised university. Additionally, students must have a valid score in TANCET. The college also accepts lateral entry for the course. The programme is spread across four semesters. MCA curriculum includes both theory and practical in every semester.Read on to know more about ofHindusthan College of Engineering and Technology MCA programme.

faqs.question: What is the fees of HICET Coimbatore MCA fees?
faqs.answer: The total tuition fee for the MCA programme offered at Hindusthan College of Engineering & Technology Coimbatore is inclusive of various components. faqs.question: What is the admission process of Hindusthan College of Engineering and Technology?
faqs.answer: In order to get admitted in Hindustan College of Engineering and Technology,   the student needs to fill out the registration forms for TNEA and pass it as it's the sole entrance examination through which HICET admits it's students.These are the subject necessary for a  student to have in class 12th like maths, physics and chemistry along with and aggregate score of 50%.After clearing the TNEA , the student will take part in counselling session along with others and will be interviewed personally.

faqs.question: Does Hindusthan College of Engineering and Technology refund fees?
faqs.answer: As per the official website of Hindusthan College of Engineering and Technology the Fee Refund Policies: 30% of the total fees will be withheld if a registration is canceled within 15 days of the registration date. 50% of the registration fees will be subtracted if you cancel your registration after 15 days but before 30 days. After 30 days of registration, there is no return for cancellations.

faqs.question: How are MBA placements at Hindusthan College of Engineering and Technology?
faqs.answer: Hindusthan College of Engineering and Technology (HICET) in Coimbatore boasts a solid MBA placement rating of 8.5/10. Reviews highlight the college's robust infrastructure and quality education, leading to a strong placement success rate of 70–80%. An 80% placement rate for MBA students, with salary packages ranging from 3.5 LPA to an impressive 15 LPA. Top recruiters like IBM and Zoho actively participate. In 2023, HICET recorded a the highest MBA placement package of INR 6 LPA, maintaining high On-Campus and Off-Campus placement rates of 92% and 75%, respectively. The college's inclusive approach accommodates students with arrears, providing opportunities with companies like Infosys, TCS, Mahindra, Dell, HP, and Citron.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with the infrastructure but dissatisfied with the placement and some of faculties.
reviews.review_text: The Infrastructure is good as it has every separate lab for every seperate courses also a library with a lot of books and the classrooms are nearby and clean. The Hostel rooms and bathroom were maintained neatly and clean by the institution and the mess food is good and sometimes it is worse, The medical facilities are not available in our college. Our institution places more importance on sports and games in our college.

reviews.review_heading: The college has good infrastructure with many facilities.
reviews.review_text: The department has good infrastructure with Wi-Fi, well-equipped labs, clean classrooms, and a resourceful library. Hostel facilities are decent. Food quality is average. Medical support is available. Sports and games facilities are satisfactory for students.

reviews.review_heading: Life at Hindusthan College.
reviews.review_text: Mechanical engineering is a very good group, and the campus is very good. The hostel is spacious, the rooms are peaceful, and the hostel food is very good. The library is very silent. The quality of facilities and hostel food is average, and the rooms are very peaceful. The course is very easy, sports are very good, and the games and canteen are of high quality. Overall everything is good.

reviews.review_heading: In 2 years, you can gain much knowledge for your career because of the lab facilities.
reviews.review_text: Our college infrastructure is good compared to other colleges. The campus is fully Wi-Fi enabled. This campus creates valuable memories of college life. The hostel life of our college is safer than that of other colleges. The food and maintenance of our college are perfect.

reviews.review_heading: Best infrastructure and placements.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure are good in our department. Library has a wide variety of textbooks related to our department. About the hostel, food is good. Many sports are available on our campus, like cricket, basketball, football, and cricket ground is also available. College provides many facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Good college campus and infrastructure. We need to walk to travel from bus stop to college.
reviews.review_text: Campus is fully Wi-Fi enabled. Lab facilities are very best. Classrooms are very neat, air availability, and more space. Library is very big with two floor separate building. First year is very neat and separate from senior hostel. 2nd, 3rd, and 4th year hostel is separate into three categories (normal, deluxe, and ultra-deluxe).

reviews.review_heading: Hindustan College of Engineering and Technology is one of the best engineering colleges.
reviews.review_text: Hindustan College of Engineering and Technology provided good infrastructure and facilities. This college had more modern laboratories and well-equipped library facilities and more spacious classrooms available. This college hostel facilities were very good. Hostel food was very healthy and tasty. More sports grounds and coaching staffs facilities were also there at this college.

reviews.review_heading: Beyond education, our college teaches not only the subjects but also the other disciplinary.
reviews.review_text: The computer labs are so good and have high-speed internet. The classrooms are also so good. My favourite place is library it is so good and peaceful. The quality of the food in the hostel is not bad. The canteen is also good for relaxing in your free time.

reviews.review_heading: Hindusthan College of Engineering and Technology has a good campus and placements for the IT field.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is neat and nice. The college has a food technology lab which includes many machines for practical laboratory studies. They also provide Wi-Fi. There is a common library for all departments which is a calm and peaceful place where we can read books related to our own subject.

reviews.review_heading: My college life in Hindusthan.
reviews.review_text: Our college infrastructure is good. It is a very green campus, and the hostel is modern. The hostel bathrooms are good, and the lab also has very advanced equipment and other things. Overall, this college's good and very nice infrastructure is best for studying in 4 years, and this campus creates a valuable memory of college life.

reviews.review_heading: NAAC and NBA approved college. Dissatisfied with the few staffs.
reviews.review_text: You will get a high-class library experience with over 10,000 books here, but no Wi-Fi facilities. Classrooms are well ventilated, and 40% have smart class facilities. All departments had their own labs. Hostel foods are average and has okay level of hygiene. Laundry facilities are available.

reviews.review_heading: Good faculty, good placements, good infrastructure, and environment.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is good, with a nice environment and many labs available. The quality of education is good. The canteens in the college are satisfactory, while the hostel food is average. This college encourages all sports and games.

reviews.review_heading: Faculty are friendly and the campus is very jolly.
reviews.review_text: The classrooms in this college are well-equipped with smart boards, which makes teaching and learning easy. The labs are well-equipped with the latest equipment. The hostels provide separate beds and bathroom facilities. Sports are an important part of college life, and the college provides excellent sports facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Overall best College for MCA Course.
reviews.review_text: The overall infrastructure of the college is excellent, and the hostel is also clean. There is a food problem in the hostel. Otherwise, it is good, and the hostel has many facilities, like playing games, etc. The hostel is cleaned daily, so it is very clean. Medical facilities are also available.

reviews.review_heading: Best engineering college in Coimbatore.
reviews.review_text:
The infrastructure of the college is good and the college area is around 200 acres, so there is plenty of space in the campus. Canteens and cafes are also there so going out with your friends is pretty good. The BTech CSE eligibility criteria is as follows:Candidates with BE/BTech degree in Computer Science and Engineering/ Information Technology / equivalent programme.Candidates with MSc (Computer Science/Information Technology)Graduates (AMIETE) from the Institution of Electronics and Telecommunication Engineers (IETE) in Computer Science and EngineeringMCA from a recognised Institution.NOTE:Candidates with any one of the above mentioned eligibility criteria will be eligible for admission.

faqs.question: How to get a M.Tech seat at IIIT Guwahati?
faqs.answer: To get an M.Tech seat at IIIT Guwahati, students are required to fulfill the eligibility and selection criteria. Those who are eligible can apply for the preferred course. After applying, those who receive a PI call must participate in the interview process. Once the PI process is over, selected students are further required to complete the document verification process and pay the admission fee to secure the seat.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best college in the Northeast after IIT Guwahati to join.
reviews.review_text: The campus totally covers an area of nearly 70 acres. The total campus is lush green. We have one administrative building where daily classes go on and are equipped with labs and the library. There are three boys hostels, two girls hostels, and one faculty member's residential building. We do find many food stalls around the campus and a student activity center.

reviews.review_heading: The college has good faculty members, good placements in 2025, infrastructure, and facilities.
reviews.review_text: The campus of the Indian Institute of Information Technology is very big. The infrastructure is also very good. There are many classrooms in college. Classrooms are equipped with AC. There is a single library. There is a town hall in which we enjoy many cultural programs. There are two canteens on our college campus and mini canteens outside the campus.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied because of its good teachers, decent placements, and super college life.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is decent enough. There is one hostel room with an attached washroom, desk, chair, and cupboard for 2 people in the library. There is availability of journals and other books. Labs are equipped with everything. Wi-Fi is available everywhere. Classrooms have whiteboards as well as a projector for smart learning. Mess is available in the hostel itself. There is a medical shop just outside the campus and a 24/7 available ambulance in case of emergencies. Both indoor and outdoor g...

reviews.review_heading: It has a decent college life and is good to study in.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is good in the academic building but it is not reliable in the hostels. Labs are decent, and the classrooms are quite comfortable. Library has a decent seating area. The hostel is good, but the food served is not good. In terms of medical facilities, we have an ambulance. There is a gym, badminton court, table tennis, carrom, chess, cricket, and football facilities available.

reviews.review_heading: A review on our campus: IIITG.
reviews.review_text:
Our campus was spread across 67 acres, including an academic block, two boys hostels, one girl hostel, 1 faculty block, a student activity center, and a lake. Facilities in our campus included 1Gbps Wi-Fi, large collections of books in library, etc.
An ambulance was available 24/7 with a medical kit. Students activity centre consists of gym, badminton court, table tennis, etc.

reviews.review_heading: A glimpse of IIIT GUWAHATI.
reviews.review_text: The complete campus is Wi-Fi enabled, the labs are well-equipped, the classrooms are well maintained, and they are digital classrooms. In the library, you can find all the books related to your academics and other books based on your interests. The mess food can be eaten and the hostel rooms are well maintained. In the room, we get a bed and a fan with attached washrooms. The mess food quality is okay, and we have quite a few canteens across the campus. The first-aid facility is readily availabl...

reviews.review_heading: It will be an amazing college in the upcoming years.
reviews.review_text: Our college has an air-conditioned academic building that is open 24/7 and labs are kept open for students to study in, the library at our college is well-equipped with books and materials needed by students. The college provides 5G Wi-Fi and a table connection. Labs are well-equipped too.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with faculty, good placements, and simple infrastructure .
reviews.review_text:
All facilities are available: 24 hours of Wi-Fi, 18 hours of library access, etc. 
We had a canteen in the academic block and a night canteen. The food available here is mainly North Indian food, twice a week: chicken and fish. For vegetarians, they provide paneer and potatoes.

reviews.review_heading: Good academic life but not campus life.
reviews.review_text: Since the campus is still under construction, most of these facilities are not available. But hostels are good and mess food is up to the mark. You can have a nice academic life. 24*7 Wi-Fi, electricity, and water supply are available. The sports complex is also undergoing construction.

reviews.review_heading: The information you should have before getting admission in iiitg.
reviews.review_text: The college campus is new so there is still some development to be made by the college. The management of college is doing its best to make a better campus everyday. The hostel is good and the infrastructure is not as good as IIT but it is enough.

reviews.review_heading: A student's opinion on IIITG.
reviews.review_text: The Academic block is equipped with Wi-Fi. There are labs for CSE students as well as for ECE students. There is a library in the institute. The books in the library are sufficient for the course. The hostel rooms are good. Each room in the hostel is shared by two people. The mess food is hygienic and tasty. There are canteens in both academic block and hostel.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely very great for its curriculum and its average placements.
reviews.review_text: Some buildings are yet to be made like there is no clubs and no gymkhana. Even the students have to go outside the campus for gym etc. There is no proper ground for football basketball. Only for cricket is present. Also the roads are full of ditches and no well furnished.

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides impressive placements.
reviews.review_text: Library is small, but students can use CSE labs for study purposes. Labs have top-notch infrastructure. Classrooms are awesome. Wi-Fi is good enough. The entire academic block has top-notch infrastructure with centralised air-conditioning. Hostel rooms are better than some IIT hostels. Mess food is not good. Medical facilities are weak. In the coming years, sports facilities will be upgraded. Work is currently going on.

reviews.review_heading: Come to this college if you like ventures.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is not up to the mark. It is quite average and not what an Institute of national importance should be like. Anyway you should come to this college only for placement purpose and not for any other things. Extracurricular activities are a strict no go.

reviews.review_heading: It is a place for uncertainty and new experiences.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are very good. Hostel is great. Laboratories are decent. There are 3 boys' hostels and 1 girls' hostel.

reviews_list.review_title: All about IIPE-by-IIPE students.

review_content.Placements: Placement percentage of our college is pretty good, it is about 97%. The average salary is 10 LPA, and the highest salary is 23 LPA. Top recruiting companies of our college are HPCL, ONGC, PSUs, Haliburton, etc. So many companies are there that provide good salaries. About 97% of students got summer internships from the college, and companies like HPCL and ONGC come for the summer internship program.
review_content.Infrastructure: Facilities of our college are pretty good. We have fully air-conditioned classrooms with one projector and good quality benches are there. Overall, classrooms are pretty good. Wi-Fi facilities are also there. We also have one library and that is also good for us. We also have good labs. Hostels of IIPE are pretty good as compared to any IITs or NITs. We have one shared room with two beds, two study tables, two cupboards, and two windows. Mess is also decent. We get decent quality food. Medical facility is good.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech in Chemical Engineering - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: I am absolutely satisfied with my college placements, especially this year.

review_content.Placements: Around 98% of students get placed. The highest package is 25 LPA from ONGC followed by Oil India. The lowest package by Mordor Intelligence India Cements ranges from 3-4 LPA. The average package is 12 LPA. Top recruiting companies are ONGC, HPCL, GAIL, HRRL, and IOCL. 100% of students got internships in the core chemical engineering sector, and we got internships in the above-mentioned PSUs. The top roles offered are process engineer and grade officer.
review_content.Infrastructure: In the chemical engineering department, Wi-Fi and labs are there including a lot of special bulk fiber commodity chemicals, XRD labs, etc. Classrooms are AC equipped, including projectors, and a seating capacity of around 50 students. Library contains more than 10,000 books including the latest journals. In hostels, mess food is good by private vendors and mess charges are around Rs. 5,500. Hostels are non-AC and AC both with single sharing and double sharing and charges that range from Rs. 30,000-40,000.

individual_reviews.title: Overall, if you are thinking of joining IIPE, you should definitely come.

content.Placements: The highest package at IIPE is around 25 LPA. In Chemical Engineering, placement is almost 100%. All PSUs that recruit for Chemical Engineering visit the campus. 100% of the 2021–2025 batch secures internships in PSUs and energy firms such as ONGC, IOCL, HPCL, and GAIL. individual_reviews.course: B.Tech in Petroleum Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: All about IIPE-by-IIPE students.

content.Placements: Placement percentage of our college is pretty good, it is about 97%. The average salary is 10 LPA, and the highest salary is 23 LPA. Top recruiting companies of our college are HPCL, ONGC, PSUs, Haliburton, etc. So many companies are there that provide good salaries. About 97% of students got summer internships from the college, and companies like HPCL and ONGC come for the summer internship program.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities of our college are pretty good. We have fully air-conditioned classrooms with one projector and good quality benches are there. Overall, classrooms are pretty good. Wi-Fi facilities are also there. We also have one library and that is also good for us. We also have good labs. Hostels of IIPE are pretty good as compared to any IITs or NITs. We have one shared room with two beds, two study tables, two cupboards, and two windows. Mess is also decent. We get decent quality food. Medical facility is good.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech in Chemical Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: I am absolutely satisfied with my college placements, especially this year.

content.Placements: Around 98% of students get placed. The highest package is 25 LPA from ONGC followed by Oil India. The lowest package by Mordor Intelligence India Cements ranges from 3-4 LPA. The average package is 12 LPA. Top recruiting companies are ONGC, HPCL, GAIL, HRRL, and IOCL. 100% of students got internships in the core chemical engineering sector, and we got internships in the above-mentioned PSUs. The top roles offered are process engineer and grade officer.
content.Infrastructure: In the chemical engineering department, Wi-Fi and labs are there including a lot of special bulk fiber commodity chemicals, XRD labs, etc. Classrooms are AC equipped, including projectors, and a seating capacity of around 50 students. Library contains more than 10,000 books including the latest journals. In hostels, mess food is good by private vendors and mess charges are around Rs. 5,500. Hostels are non-AC and AC both with single sharing and double sharing and charges that range from Rs. 30,000-40,000.

The only problem is that college campus is not ready and it takes some time.

review_summary.college_name: IGDTUW Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical and Automation Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: My college campus is small but beautiful, and the placement is very good.

content.Placements: 70-75 percent of students are placed in my college. The highest placement of my branch is 1 crore, and the lowest is 6-8 LPA. Because it's a women's college, so the companies that require women for completion of ratio come to my college, so many big companies like Google, Amazon, and Microsoft visit my college.
content.Infrastructure: My college is very small, but beautiful. Wi-Fi condition is okay. Classroom condition is also okay. The library is very good. The hostel provides me with facilities like a freezer and an oven. The canteen is small, but the food tastes good. Medical facilities are good, and sports and games are okay.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: My own IGDTUW experience.

content.Placements: Almost 70%-80% of students are placed in internships for the third year. The top roles offered are SDE intern, Adapt intern, etc. Top recruiting companies are Wells Fargo and ServiceNow. The highest package, I guess, is 1.5 LPA for an intern, Rs. 45,000 minimum.
content.Infrastructure: There is a Wi-Fi connection, and it works well. Overall, the classrooms are decent and air-conditioned, and the library is also pretty good. The quality of facilities in the hostel is good. They provide medical facilities, a mess, and everything. My favourite spot is the library.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Good placement, good infrastructure (not as good as other colleges).

content.Placements: Around 70% students, who were eligible to sit in placements, got placed last year. The highest package is around 50 LPA, and the lowest can be expected as 3 LPA-4 LPA. The off-campus placement has even offered a 1 crore per annum package to a student. Internships are offered only to CSE students most of the time. However, the average stipend is around Rs. 30,000, but not all the students get internships on campus. The role you get solely depends on your skill level and your interview.
content.Infrastructure: The college does not have a huge campus area, but it is fine. Washrooms, rooms, ground, and labs are cleaned, proper lighting, AC rooms, titles over the floor and walls. Wi-Fi works well, the library is also well-maintained, and different types of books are available. However, the condition of the hostel is not very good, as the building is old, but the management tries to do everything to make it comfortable for the students. Mess food is also fine, the canteen menu is not too lengthy, but momos and spring rolls are tasty for sure.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Reviewing my college IGDTUW.

content.Placements: The placement is very good here, and many companies visit this college. Even before placement, all the companies visit this college to guide students and help them to prepare for the interview and the selection process, and it is called pre-placement talks, which definitely gives college students an edge over those students who are appearing from outside the college.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel is average. They provide basics like AC, decent food, decent water to drink, and basic rooms are small, washing machines are 2 per washroom, but not all of them work, but some do, which teaches you patience. The hostel timings are very strict. You have to be in the hostel till 8:00 PM, but if you want to go to the college computer lab, then you can stay there till 11:00 PM.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: IGDTUW offers a balanced college experience with scope to grow if you use opportunities well.

content.Placements: For batch 2024, B.Tech CSE at IGDTUW, 77% of students got placed, with the highest package of 56 LPA, and the average package is 25.15 LPA. Internships are secured by most third & fourth-year students via companies like Microsoft, Adobe, JP Morgan, etc., with roles mostly in software dev, backed, cloud, and data analysis.
content.Infrastructure: IGDTUW has decent Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and a library. The hostel is basic with average mess food, the canteen is okay, medical help is limited, and sports facilities exist but need better upkeep. Overall, the infrastructure is functional but not exceptional.

Btecg and BArch admission/ counselling throughJoint Admission Committee (JAC)is ongoing for 2025.GDTUWis awomen-only technical universitythat offers technical and management courses. Some of the popular courses offered by the certified university are BTech, BBA, MBA, MCA, BArch, etc.IGDTUWadmission to the offered courses is based onnational-level entrance exams. The university also offers PhD in direct and regular mode. Moreover, candidates shall check the eligibility conditions for the course before the form is filled out.
