Candidates willing to take admission at IGDTUW must complete the admission process as per the university's admission guidelines. IGDTUW admission process is a multi-step process which is different for every other course. Candidates must make sure to read carefully the admission process for their desired course. Find below the IGTUW admission process for 2025:
Step 1: Application Process 2025

Candidates must first register themselves to begin the application process. BTech/BArch programme's admission is done via the Joint Admission Counseling (JAC). Therefore candidates must visit the official website of JAC and register there by providing all the required details. For, BBA/ MBA candidates must apply through CMAC's official website. Further, for the rest PG and PhD programme candidates must apply via the IGTUW's official website.
Step 2: Selection Process

Candidate's applications are scrutinised for the selection process. For, BTech JEE Main's score is considered for selection and BBA/BArch programme's selection is done based on the last qualifying exam.MAT, CAT, and GATEexams are considered for the MBA/MTech/MPlan programme selection. For MCA the selection is done based onCUETconducted by the university and finally for the PhD selection is done based on theXAT RATfollowed by an interview.
Step 3: Merit list/Seat allotment

UG candidates must register for the JAC counselling for seat allotment. Based on the selection process the university releases a provisional list with candidates' names who have qualified for the selection round.
Step 4: Final selection
Once steps 1, 2, and 3 are completed seats are allotted as per the admission/ counselling bodies. Candidates must pay the admission fee to confirm the seat.

placement_data.title: IGDTUW Placement Overview 2024
paragraphs: IGDTUW has a placement cell that is responsible for securing lucrative career opportunities for students. The institute invites companies from different sectors to conduct the placement process at the Campus premises.

As per the latest report, IGDTUW recorded 69.3% placements for the Class of 2024. A total of 135 recruiters participated during the IGDTUW placement in 2024 and placed 537 students of the 2024 batch. The participating recruiters placed 56 CSE AI students, 145 CSE, 125 IT, 95 ECE and 64 MAE students of the BTech batch 2024. Additionally, the MCA batch 2024 consists of 74 students, of whom 49 were placed with handsome packages. The highest and average package offered to the BTech CSE batch 2024 stood at INR 56 LPA and INR 25.15 LPA , respectively. Further, the highest and average package offered to the MCA students during IGDTUW placements 2024 stood at INR 52.89 LPA and INR 14.13 LPA , respectively.

Apart from offering placement opportunities, IGDTUW also offers internship opportunities to the students of the Class 2024. According to the report, 427 students received internship offers from reputed organizations. The top recruiters who participated during IGDTUW placement in 2024 included Google, Adobe, Palo Alto, Microsoft, Uber, Atlassian, BNY Mellon, Deloitte, JP Morgan, Cisco, PWC, Salesforce, Morgan Stanley, Goldman Sachs, British Telecom, etc.

reviews.review_heading: My college campus is small but beautiful, and the placement is very good.
reviews.review_text: My college is very small, but beautiful. Wi-Fi condition is okay. Classroom condition is also okay. The library is very good. The hostel provides me with facilities like a freezer and an oven. The canteen is small, but the food tastes good. Medical facilities are good, and sports and games are okay.

reviews.review_heading: My own IGDTUW experience.
reviews.review_text: There is a Wi-Fi connection, and it works well. Overall, the classrooms are decent and air-conditioned, and the library is also pretty good. The quality of facilities in the hostel is good. They provide medical facilities, a mess, and everything. My favourite spot is the library.

reviews.review_heading: Good placement, good infrastructure (not as good as other colleges).
reviews.review_text: The college does not have a huge campus area, but it is fine. Washrooms, rooms, ground, and labs are cleaned, proper lighting, AC rooms, titles over the floor and walls. Wi-Fi works well, the library is also well-maintained, and different types of books are available. However, the condition of the hostel is not very good, as the building is old, but the management tries to do everything to make it comfortable for the students. Mess food is also fine, the canteen menu is not too lengthy, but momo...

reviews.review_heading: Reviewing my college IGDTUW.
reviews.review_text: The hostel is average. They provide basics like AC, decent food, decent water to drink, and basic rooms are small, washing machines are 2 per washroom, but not all of them work, but some do, which teaches you patience. The hostel timings are very strict. You have to be in the hostel till 8:00 PM, but if you want to go to the college computer lab, then you can stay there till 11:00 PM.

reviews.review_heading: IGDTUW offers a balanced college experience with scope to grow if you use opportunities well.
reviews.review_text: IGDTUW has decent Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and a library. The hostel is basic with average mess food, the canteen is okay, medical help is limited, and sports facilities exist but need better upkeep. Overall, the infrastructure is functional but not exceptional.

reviews.review_heading: College has good placements with a decent curriculum. But the infrastructure needs improvement.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure at IGDTUW is satisfactory but has scope for improvement. Wi-Fi works well in the academic blocks but is inconsistent in hostels and some areas. Labs are functional but could be better equipped. Classrooms in ECE and CSE generally lack air-conditioning, which can be challenging during peak summers. Library provides good resources but often falls short on seating capacity during exams. Campus has a spacious ground for sports and activities. Although I haven't stayed in the hostel, f...

reviews.review_heading: If you want placement then definitely go for it.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is like average because only few classes have AC in them. The campus is very small. Hostel is not good at all. Lab classes have AC but others are non-AC. But in 2025 IT block will have AC in all the rooms in which the classes for CS, AI, IT, and AIML take place.

reviews.review_heading: Great placement opportunities.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is average. You don't need to walk a lot to get to your classes like other colleges. Facilities are not up to expectations. You don't have a proper seating arrangement to have your food in the canteen. We do have Nescafé where you can enjoy yourself. The campus is shared by the students of Dr B. R. Ambedkar. The sports societies are active. Most of the computers don't work in the labs, and the library gets crowded most of the time.

reviews.review_heading: Good exposure and opportunities, a supportive environment, and improving placements.
reviews.review_text: The overall infrastructure of IGDTUW is average. Wi-Fi is available across the campus but not always reliable. Labs are equipped for basic requirements, though some equipment is outdated. Classrooms are spacious with projectors. The library is useful with good resources. Hostel facilities are manageable, with rooms of decent size and average cleanliness. The mess food is also average, sometimes good, sometimes just okay, with better options available in the canteen. Medical facilities are basic....

reviews.review_heading: Strong placement and supportive faculty, but infrastructure needs improvement.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of the institute is below average when compared to the top government colleges in India. The library often remains overcrowded making it difficult for students to study comfortably. Classrooms are not fully centralized. In addition, Wi-Fi connectivity is restricted to only a few specific labs, limiting accessibility across the campus. The quality of hostel food also falls short of expectations and requires significant improvement.

reviews.review_heading: Great placements and campus.
reviews.review_text: The overall infrastructure of the campus is well maintained and student friendly. The academic facilities include spacious classrooms with modern teaching aids, fully equipped labs and well stocked library with access to online journals. Hostel facilities are quite comfortable providing all the basic needs. The mess food is hygienic and offers a variety of food.

reviews.review_heading: I am truly satisfied with my faculty, college life, friends, and the new experiences I have gained.
reviews.review_text: The IT department is newly built and has smart boards in almost every class. Wi-Fi can only be accessed on the 1st floor of IT and the library. Classrooms are good and spacious, but still sometimes congested. The library is well-managed and has lots of books related to our course. I am not a hosteler, so I don't know about it.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, this college is really good.
reviews.review_text: They have AC only in the IT department and in labs. Food quality is average, like any other college. Hostel is not that good, they provide AC only to 1st years, plus you have bunkers bed in first year, like 6 people sharing a room for AC. In others, there are triple, so overall hostel is not that good.

reviews.review_heading: My review of this college.
reviews.review_text: Hostel facilities are nice, only two students have to share the room. 24/7 Wi-Fi facility in the hostel, as well as water and electricity facility, is also minimal. The hostel mess food is also good and hygienic as it is checked every weekend, and there are timing restrictions from 9:00 PM onwards, nobody is allowed.

reviews.review_heading: Good placement in 2025 and in the ECE-AI department. Infrastructure should be improved.
reviews.review_text: The ECE-AI department at IGDTUW has an average environment. They provide good and well-equipped labs with Wi-Fi facilities. There is a decent library. Some facilities are a bit outdated. I'm a day scholar, but one of my best friend is a hosteller, she told me about hostel that it is just poor, like the food is so bad and tasteless, rooms are so small, and the rules and regulations are so strict. The medical facilities available are below average. The classrooms are not fully air-conditioned in E...

college_info.intro: Jamia Hamdard University New Delhi popular programmes are BTech, BPharma, and MBA. For MBA students, the university organises Biz-Quiz, Management Fests, Debates, Ad-mad shows, and others. Hamdard New Delhi also arranges guest lectures & student and faculty exchange programmes for MBA students. MBA students can work as Marketing Managers, Consultants, & also Finance Managers, or can take up several other job opportunities. overview_faqs.question: Is hostel fee refunded in case of admission cancellation at Jamia Hamdard?
overview_faqs.answer: In case a student does not join the hostel but informs the Provost Office within a week after payment of the hostel fee about the withdrawal, the hostel charges are then refunded after deduction of INR 1000. In any other case, no fee except security deposit is refundable. It is refunded to the hosteller after he/she has paid all dues and vacated the hostel.

Candidates meeting the eligibility criteria have to register for the course of their choice on the official website of the university. Aspirants must upload the documents and pay the application fee to apply for a programme.
STEP 2: Selection Rounds

Jamia Hamdard selects candidates for most of the courses based on national-level entrance exams. The university accepts JEE Main, CAT, MAT, XAT, NEET, etc. for admission to specific courses. For a few programme, the university might consider merit in the last qualifying exam. MBBS and BPharm are the top programme of Jamia Hamdard. Admission to both is through NEET-UG. The university also accepts JEE Main for for BPharm.
STEP 3: Selection List and Counselling

After completion of all the selection rounds, Jamia Hamdard releases a selection list with the names of shortlisted candidates. Such candidates recieve an email with further instructions. Shortlisted aspirants need to come for counselling round along with the below documents for verification:

Jamia Hamdard is cumulative of multiple components such as tuition fee, hostel fee, library deposit, caution deposit, etc. Some of the fee components are one-time paid, while some have to be paid semester-wise or annually, such as tuition fees. faqs.question: Is Jamia Hamdard University under CUET?
faqs.answer: Yes, Jamia Hamdard offers admission to students on the basis of CUET entrance exam. The college will release the final merit list of the basis of scores obtained by the students in this exam. Candidates can check the official website for more information.

faqs.question: How can I get admission in Jamia Hamdard?
faqs.answer: Jamia Hamdard releases its recent admission guidelines or prospectus on the official website a the start of the admission for each academic year. Students must check the course-wise eligibility and selection criteria and follow the process. Admission to all the courses is either merit or entrance based. For instance, admission to the BTech and MBBS courses are subject to JEE Main and NEET UG exams, However, for courses, such as BCA, admission is subject to merit in Class 12 in the best of five subjects. Additionally,  the deemed-to-be University accepts CUET UG conducted by NTA for a few of its UG courses, namely BA, BA (Hons), BSc (Hons), BBA, BJMC and BCom.

faqs.question: What is the cutoff of Jamia Hamdard?
faqs.answer: The cutoff for Jamia Hamdard University is the minimum marks that a candidate must achieve to get considered for admission to Jamia Hamdard University. The cutoff is diverse for each category and course. For example, the cutoff for the MBBS programme is quite different for General category students as compared with the OBC students. The cutoff marks and scores for Jamia Hamdard University are decided by quite a number of factors, including the total seats available for the students, the number of applicants, and the average scores of the various applicants. The cutoff is generally released after the results are released for the NEET. For cutoff-related details, please visit the official website of Jamia Hamdard University.

faqs.question: How can I get admission to Jamia Hamdard BSc programme?
faqs.answer: Jamia Hamdard admit candidates to the BSc courses based on merit in the last qualifying examination. Hence, the applicants scores in Class 12 or equivalent exam are considered. For admission to BSc Nursing course, students are required to take the Jamia Hamdard entrance exam. However, it select students on merit-basis as well.Before applying for a course, aspirants should check out the course-specific eligibility criteria. The eligible students can apply for the desired course on the university official website.

placement_data.title: Jamia Hamdard Placement Overview 2025
paragraphs: According to the Annual Report 2024-25 released, a total of 28 students were placed from the School of Pharmaceutical Education & Research (SPER). The salary package recorded during Jamia Hamdard placements for SPER was between INR 3 LPA and 26 LPA . From School of Nursing Sciences and Allied Health (SNSAH), 99 students were placed with salary package ranging from 3 LPA to 6 LPA .

During Jamia Hamdard placements 2025, 45 students were placed and 45 students opted for higher studies from School of Engineering Sciences and Technology (SEST). The top recruiters included Accenture and Deloitte .

In School of Chemical and Life Sciences (SCLS), 29 students were placed with salary package between 2.5 LPA and 4.5 LPA . Further, 12 students of School of Interdisciplinary Sciences and Technology were placed with package between 1.2 LPA and 10 LPA .
In Centre for Media and Mass Communication, 5 students were placed with salary package between 3 LPA and 5 LPA during Jamia Hamdard placement 2025.

reviews.review_heading: If you want to relax and only degree, then go.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are enough, okay, but infrastructure needs construction, and some classes are not well organized. So Wi-Fi also does work proper. The hostel is good, but there is also a bad thing about wash room. Overall, there is no much facilities provide as other.

reviews.review_heading: Truly satisfied with the campus life and facilities.
reviews.review_text: Amazing infrastructure; they provide Wi-Fi, AC classrooms, a decent library, and they have around 4–5 canteens with good quality food. They conduct sports events and tournaments every few months, so overall a good experience. I don’t have any idea about hostel, but the rest everything is nice, and they also have a hospital on campus.

reviews.review_heading: I am not saying that the college is bad, but the students are.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are average. Only the canteen, campus, and medical facilities are good, the rest are average. The library is noisy every time I see it. Labs are not good, systems don't work often. Only cricket is good, no other sport. Everything is taken lightly, and there are fights very often.

reviews.review_heading: Faculty members and placements are good every year, and the infrastructure is average.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is above average, and we can rate it 4/10. Some cons include lift issues and Wi-Fi speed. Labs have almost all the required equipment. Hostel facilities are average. They charge a high amount, but facilities are not worth it. Mess and canteen are available, and their prices are reasonable. Medical facilities are good, as we have a hospital and a rehabilitation centre. In sports, we have football, volleyball, badminton, basketball, cricket, table tennis, carrom, and chess. We need ...

reviews.review_heading: Not the best but not the worst either.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi service is available, but it rarely works, and data services are negligible here. A lot of issues arise because of that. Classrooms are normal college classrooms with no AC and old fans. The library is functional with a huge number of books but most are outdated. The hostel facilities are great with good rooms, AC, and water supply. The curfew time is 9:30 PM, and the food is a bit hygienic, but not that bad. The sports facilities are great with a huge ground available, and other sports eq...

reviews.review_heading: Poor infrastructure, bad class management, no placements, but good faculty.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is not good. Wi-Fi works only in specific places. Labs are okay, but water facilities and chemicals are missing, and equipment does not work. The hostel is good overall, and the food is good. Safety is a priority, and the hospital is nearby. There is a sports week, and the main focus is on sports and games too.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2029Offered by Hamdard Institute of Medical  Sciences And Research, New DelhiReviewed on 16 Aug 2025)
reviews.review_heading: It is a cute college with nice studies.
reviews.review_text: Hostel facilities are not that great. Food is also okay, not very good, and not very bad either. Hostels are clean. College has an AC lecture theatre, library, and computer labs. Washrooms are nice. The college is overall not very big, but it has a cozy vibe.

reviews.review_heading: Jamia Hamdard University review.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi and labs are available for students, and a maximum of 60 students can be in a classroom. The library is also available to assist students. Safe and separate hostels with good hygienic food quality are available for boys and girls. Majeedia Hospital provides medical facilities, and sports grounds are available for games.

reviews.review_heading: Review by a CSE day scholar student.
reviews.review_text: Facilities like classrooms are non-AC. Only the ground floor which are the LT classrooms are smart classes with AC and projector. Other classrooms are without AC. The hostel is good with a lot of facilities like laundry, Wi-Fi and electricity all over. The mess is also good. The food is also good there.

reviews.review_heading: Review by student living life on campus.
reviews.review_text: Facilities like classrooms are non-AC. Only the ground floor which are the LT classrooms are smart classes with AC and projector. Other classes also have projectors but without AC. The hostel is good with a lot of facilities like laundry, Wi-Fi and electricity all over. The mess is also good. The food is also good there.

reviews.review_heading: Review of the evergreen Jamia Hamdard University.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the course is well-maintained. It has Wi-Fi, computer labs for doing editing on photoshops, Premiere Pro, Adobe software, and studios for news and radio. It provides a lot of hands-on workshops. The interior of the college where students sit is well-organised and has 99 names of Allah, where everyone feels peace alone at their free time.

reviews.review_heading: The college has supportive faculty, a room with solid placement, and is industry-ready.
reviews.review_text: Jamia Hamdard offers well-equipped laps, Wi-Fi, modern classrooms, a rich library diverse sports facilities, and so on. The campus has a hygienic mess and canteen, reliable medical services, and a sports complex for indoor and outdoor games ensuring holistic student development.

reviews.review_heading: Campus is so clean and green. It was not good in past 2010 but now it is so good.
reviews.review_text: Everything is provided on our campus like Wi-Fi and AC. Classrooms have desks and furniture. Especially every building has its own library. There are certain canteens also with good quality food. Boys and girls have separate hostels and hygiene is also good in hostels.

reviews.review_heading: Overall the campus is beautiful teachers are helpful and cooperative, and the placements are okay.
reviews.review_text: The Wi-Fi does not work properly and the college campus has jammers so cell internet doesn't work. Classrooms are getting better in facilities. There are overpriced snacks and food like coffee around 150ml is for Rs. 40 which is very helpful in summer. The campus events can be good if the management is done properly.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the campus, really good teaching staff and faculty.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good. The buildings are old. Well-equipped Labs and Classroom. The central library is the famous building of our college. The campus is very large and vast.  It has a hostel facility for girls. There are so many Pgs nearby. The food is very tasty. More than 6 canteens are there. A very sports complex is there with a Gym, basketball court volleyball, football, badminton, and tennis court.

reviews.review_heading: ROI is not what you expect, so you have to step up and take your own responsibility.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is no doubt top-notch. The only issue is they are taking bulk student intake, which affects the mess being jammed-packed some days. The library during exam times is crowded, you won't find seats there, but on exam days it is good.

reviews.review_heading: Moderately satisfied with the university.
reviews.review_text: Generally, for the Computer Science department, there are many facilities, like Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, a library, etc. Hostel facilities are okay. The quality of food is very good compared to other colleges. College also has a dispensary and various sports facilities are provided.

reviews.review_heading: Well-equipped infrastructure, supportive teachers, and industry-relevant curriculum with scope.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available in my department are well-equipped to support both academic and practical learning. Classrooms are spacious, well-lit, and equipped with projectors and audio-visual aids, making lectures more engaging. Wi-Fi connectivity is available throughout the department, enabling students to conduct research and access study materials online.

reviews.review_heading: Jaypee University of Information Technology: The college is only good due to it's location.
reviews.review_text: The food in the mess hall is terrible. Sometimes we find cooked insects in our food. The facilities aren't that good, and for every small issue we're sent to the hospital from our dispensary because we don't have proper resources to solve the problem. On the plus side, the college does have a few sports facilities, including basketball, badminton, football (only for boys), and cricket (only for boys).

reviews.review_heading: Jaypee University Of Information Technology.
reviews.review_text: The hostel facilities available here are really good. The room availability is single, two, and three occupancy rooms with spacious rooms and clean washrooms. Wi-Fi for each floor works okayish. Coed mess. One girls' hostel and 13 boys' hostels with separate buildings for first year.

reviews.review_heading: Empowering Minds: A Comprehensive Review.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure for hostel and course is overall very good with 24/7 Wi-Fi, library with reading space, clean drinking water, up-to-date computer and science labs, smart classrooms. Hostel rooms are also good with blowers for winters, and the mess food is really good compared to other universities. There is also a dispensary that is open all the time for medicine, and two doctors are there till 5 PM.

reviews.review_heading: Amazing location of the university .
reviews.review_text:
The facilities like Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and libraries are all good.
Hostel facilities are also great. The best part is the food. The food tastes amazing. It is difficult to find good food away from home in hostels. 
Everything is hygienic, and canteen food is also great.
Sports and outdoor games are wonderfully organised and set up. Dispensary is available 24/7, and doctors are so calm and nice.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Jaypee University of information technology CSE (B.Tech).
reviews.review_text: The facility of my college is very good and the class is also clean. There is Wi-Fi facility. And the library there is very big and we have good books there. The quality of the hostel there is very good. We get proper food in the hostel. The quality of food is also good. Medical facilities are also good. Sports are also good, be it cricket or kabaddi.

reviews.review_heading: College life at JUIT is amazing.
reviews.review_text:
There are several labs in our college, including physics labs, and 3 floors full of computer labs with moderate-to-high-end PC's for everyone. There is wifi at university in every corner of the campus.there are 2 libraries: one is called dhyan Kaksh, which is small and just for peace reading  and one is LRC, which is 4-story library full of books. We have several classroom's and lecture halls for academic lectures and tech hackathons, etc.
There are 4 hostels in our campus: 1 is for 1st year boy...

reviews.review_heading: Not recommended for B.Tech; placement cell is not good.
reviews.review_text: The labs are Wi-Fi enabled, with the latest PCs which were set up this year only. The classrooms are good too, with whiteboards and classboards. The library has three floors and is highly recommended for studying there. It's a very quiet place and is open up to midnight. The hostel rooms are quite good with a nice view, but there is no place for midnight cravings, although there are coffee and snacks vending machines and the cafeteria is open up to 11 PM.

reviews.review_heading: It is quite a good college .
reviews.review_text:
Food is good for mess. 
There is a Wi-Fi limit of 5 GB per day per student. 
And the infrastructure is good as well.
I will say that it is quite a good college with beautiful buildings and views as it is located in mountains and is just an hour away from Shimla .

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with the good placements.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available in the department are good. Wi-Fi is available throughout the college, and the classrooms are well-maintained. The labs are equipped with good equipment, and the library is well-stocked with all necessary books. The food quality is acceptable.

reviews.review_heading: Good college in Solan for B.Tech.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is very good. The college is in Solan, which is in the mountains region, so we get a very good area and weather here. The classes are equipped with Wi-Fi and AC all over the campus. The hostels are big and good with a mess that offers very good food.

reviews.review_heading: Infrastructure is excellent in our college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is very good, as most of the indoor spaces inside the college are centrally air-conditioned. The seats in the classrooms are well taken care of, and our library has open Wi-Fi for the use of students and teachers. The food in the mess and cafe is also good.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Jaypee University of Information Technology.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is great so many facilities are available inside the campus; you don't have to run outside. The hostel also provides so many facilities, like a 3-course meal in the mess with great taste and the gym is open full-time for your good. Water coolers and 24*7 Wi-Fi are also available .

overview_faqs.question: What is unique about JIS College of Engineering?
overview_faqs.answer: JIS College of Engineering has been one of the top institutes in the state of West Bengal. Currently, it has been ranked second after IIT Kharagpur in the NIRF Rankings for Innovation, and these two institutions are the only ones in the state to get that ranking. It has also built a new AICTE IDEA Lab on its campus, which is the third IDEA Lab in the state. With its amazing industry partnerships, it has built the lab for industrial production and will sustain the lab in the upcoming years. There is a very vibrant campus life at the college for all the students. It also provides internships and training to all students in every semester.

review_summary.college_name: JIS College of Engineering Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: About great campus life and supportive faculty, with decent placements.

content.Placements: Placements are decent, especially for CSE and IT branches. Many companies like TCS, Wipro, Cognizant, and Tech Mahindra visit the campus. Average package ranges from 3 LPA to 4 LPA, with some students getting higher offers through off-campus drives. Placement cell is supportive but can bring more core companies for non-CS branches.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is modern and well-maintained. Labs and classrooms are well-equipped. Wi-Fi is available across the campus. Hostel is clean and safe with good food. The Wi-Fi speed and room maintenance can be improved. Library is large and helpful during exams.

individual_reviews.course: BBA in Digital Marketing - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: The brightest future.

content.Placements: I am currently pursuing, but our previous year's batch also got 70 to 80% placed. The highest package is 6-7 LPA, the medium is 3-4 LPA, and the lowest is 2-2.5 LPA. Top recruiters are TCS, Wipro, and Infosys. Internship is 60-70%. Top roles are social media executive, SEO analyst, etc. There are brighter professions.
content.Infrastructure: We have Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and a library. Here, we have maintained a well-facilitated environment. The hostel food is average good, hygiene is maintained, and medical facilities, sports, and games are fine. The overall hostel is very nice and peaceful. This provides a non-ragging campus.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: I am dissatisfied with my college due to the language barrier.

content.Placements: At least 10% of students are placed at this college. The highest package is 4.5 LPA in this course. Top recruiting companies are Capgemini and TCS. 5% of students get internships. Top roles offered are web developer and cyber security, but the highest package is very low, like 4.5 LPA is so low.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities are very low, no Wi-Fi on the college campus, and they have tiny rooms. They have a library, but the food quality is very low. They have a mess hall or canteen, but the food quality is very low. They have a big ground for sports. They participate in sports or tournaments, and they also have medical facilities.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Technology - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Supportive environment with active campus life and solid placements.

content.Placements: 70% of students got placed in my course. The highest package is 10 LPA, the average package is 5 LPA, and the lowest package is 2.5 LPA. In my course, the top recruiting companies are TCS, Capgemini, etc. 60% of students secured internships from this course at IBM, TCS, Infosys, etc. The top roles in this course are software developer, data analyst, and technical support.
content.Infrastructure: Classrooms are smart-class enabled, with projectors and good seating. It has NG arrangements also. Wi-Fi is available across campus, though like most colleges, sometimes the speed can dip. Hostel facilities are fairly comfortable. Rooms are decent-and are usually shared. They come with the basics: a bed, study tables, and proper ventilation. Hostel food is average; it's not home-style cooking, but it's hygienic and filling. Many students rely on the canteen when they want variety. There is a medical room on campus with a doctor available at certain hours. Sports and extracurricular activities are encouraged. The college has grounds for cricket, football, and volleyball.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information Technology - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Excellent campus life, average academics, affordable fees, but outdated teaching methods.

content.Placements: At JIS Kalyani, most of the students got placed from the CSE department but ECE and mechanical department students also got placed at top companies. Companies like Accenture, Wipro, TCS, Capgemini, L&T, and many more non-multinational companies. Internship is totally dependent on student's skill and way of approach.
content.Infrastructure: JIS is the first college of JIS Group so the infrastructure is good and well. College architecture is also good regarding the stars lift, stationary shop, and student counseling office. Hostel is also good. But there are many more messes near college so options are available. Food is a bit good in the canteen.

reviews.review_heading: The brightest future.
reviews.review_text: We have Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and a library. Here, we have maintained a well-facilitated environment. The hostel food is average good, hygiene is maintained, and medical facilities, sports, and games are fine. The overall hostel is very nice and peaceful. This provides a non-ragging campus.

They have a mess hall or canteen, but the food quality is very low. They have a big ground for sports. They participate in sports or tournaments, and they also have medical facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Supportive environment with active campus life and solid placements.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are smart-class enabled, with projectors and good seating. It has NG arrangements also. Wi-Fi is available across campus, though like most colleges, sometimes the speed can dip. Hostel facilities are fairly comfortable. Rooms are decent-and are usually shared. They come with the basics: a bed, study tables, and proper ventilation. Hostel food is average; it's not home-style cooking, but it's hygienic and filling. Many students rely on the canteen when they want variety. There is a med...

reviews.review_heading: Excellent campus life, average academics, affordable fees, but outdated teaching methods.
reviews.review_text: JIS is the first college of JIS Group so the infrastructure is good and well. College architecture is also good regarding the stars lift, stationary shop, and student counseling office. Hostel is also good. But there are many more messes near college so options are available. Food is a bit good in the canteen.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure, supportive faculty, moderate placements, and average hostel food.
reviews.review_text:
Infrastructure is impressive, with well-equipped classrooms and modern labs that enhance the learning experience. Hostel facilities are good, providing a comfortable stay, though the food quality is average.
Faculty members are knowledgeable and supportive. Curriculum is relevant, and the exam structure is manageable, allowing students to balance academics and skill development.

reviews.review_heading: I know myself because of our faculty and what I want to do in my life. Thank you.
reviews.review_text: The college classrooms are good, and the lab classes are also good. I don't know about the hostel because I used to delay traveling.

reviews.review_heading: Great campus life, strong placements, and practical learning experience.
reviews.review_text: Computer science and engineering department was well-equipped with modern Wi-Fi-enabled classrooms, advanced computer labs, and dedicated AI/ML and cybersecurity labs with high-performance systems. Smart boards, projectors, and audio systems were available in most classrooms for interactive learning. The central library was fully digitized and stocked with thousands of technical books, research journals, and access to online databases like IEEE, Springer, and JSTOR. Campus offered 24X7 Wi-Fi con...

reviews.review_heading: Good placements of batch 2021-2025.
reviews.review_text: Facilities for the hostel are just awesome, students can live with comfort.

reviews.review_heading: JISCE CSE - supportive teachers, solid curriculum, and decent placements with scope for self-growth.
reviews.review_text: Hostel life at JIS College of Engineering is safe, decent, and comfortable for students, especially for those from outside Kalyani. While food and Wi-Fi could be improved, the security, study environment, and proximity to campus make it a good choice for students focused on academics and placements.

reviews.review_heading: Decent placements, but your success depends on you.
reviews.review_text: As a CSE student at JIS, I would say our facilities get the job done. The labs are pretty good and our library is well-stocked. It's where everyone is heading now that classes are over for the day. Wi-Fi can be a bit unreliable outside of those spots, though. Life after class is what you would expect, hostel rooms are basic and the mess food gets repetitive fast, which is why the canteen is always busy.

reviews.review_heading: Reliable placements, great infrastructure, and supportive faculty at JIS college.
reviews.review_text: Lecture halls and smart Classrooms are there. 80+ ICT-enabled rooms with projectors and smart boards. 72 specialized labs, Electronics, Mechanical, Language, CAD, STAAD, etc. Central library with 88,000+ books, 121 print journals, RFID system, e-resources (IEEE, NDL, NPTEL). Hostel facility for both Boys & Girls. Hostels have a total of 700+ beds; 24/7 security, power backup, Wi-Fi, indoor games, and a canteen. Mess & Canteen are not Hygienic, and the menu can be repetitive; night canteen avail...

reviews.review_heading: The college campus and placements are very good. I would recommend this college who are interested.
reviews.review_text: The facilities are good and Wi-Fi in the college is also very good. The labs, classrooms and library are very nice. Wi-Fi connection is good enough for reading. The food is also very good and clean.

reviews.review_heading: A little bit satisfied with this college.
reviews.review_text: All are average, not as good as tier 1 colleges. Wi-Fi is kind of good, and lab facilities are also well maintained. I don't know about hostel food, but canteen and sports are pretty good. You will get a ground where students use to play cricket, football, volleyball, etc. Apart from this, indoor games facilities are also available.

reviews.review_heading: This college is one of the best in Kolkata.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure are good in my department. Wi-Fi is available. Labs are well-equipped. Some labs have AC. Some classroom is A.C. classroom. Library is good and has a good number of books. Hostel is good. Mess and canteen are also good. Medical facility is good, and sports facilities are also among the best.

review_summary.college_name: JSS Academy of Technical Education Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Good infrastructure with a green campus and decent hostels, supportive faculty.

content.Placements: The percentage of students placed is average. The highest package offered in CSE core is 45 to 50 LPA and the lowest package offered is 4 to 8 LPA. Top recruiting companies like TCS, Wipro, Infosys, IBM, HCL, Tech Mahindra, Samsung, and Amazon. The internship ratio is 100 percent but it depends on students skills and interests.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure are like a green campus and decent hostel including Wi-Fi, a classroom with projectors and a library. The quality of hostel food is moderate not too bad contains four meals and hostels also have medical support 24/7, including outdoor and indoor games.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Hoping for a better placement rate in JSS, good infrastructure, and focus on skills.

content.Placements: I recently enrolled in this college, and as I have heard before, 2022, its placement was so good, even in 2020, the highest package was 60 LPA at Google. But as of now, the placement condition is too bad. Big companies are not coming to recruit, the average is only 4 LPA-6 LPA. But I am hoping that in the Next 3-4 years, the placement ratio will improve, and even big companies can also recruit.
content.Infrastructure: For infrastructure, I would say neither is too good like IIT, NIT, IIMs infra, nor too bad like other tier-2 colleges. Hostel infrastructure is better both for boys and girls. Even though the capacity is low and the buildings are old, it is a better place for B.Tech students.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering(Data Science) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Harsh reality of JSSATE Noida.

content.Placements: Around 20 to 30 percent of students are placed. As of now, the highest package is around 15 LPA and the lowest around 3 LPA. Top recruiting companies include Accenture, Wipro, Deloitte, etc. There is no exact information about how many got internships from the course, but I guess very few, around 5 to 6, will be able to get paid internships, otherwise, most of them got unpaid internships.
content.Infrastructure: Labs are not well equipped like a typical government college. Hostels are decent; you will get both AC and non-AC rooms. Mess food is very bad, but I prefer the college hostel at least in the first year. This college is not for you if you love sports and games, no proper facilities are there.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely satisfied because of the faculty, good placement and infrastructure.

content.Placements: The placement record in college is 87 percent of students gets placed in 2024-25. The highest package is 48 LPA and lowest package is 4 LPA, and the median package is 6 LPA-8 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Infosys and Wipro. Top roles offered by companies are data development and software development.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is overall good. The labs are well. The library has AC, with good environment for studying. The hostel facility is okay. The bathrooms are not well furnished and mostly have construction issues. The food quality is okay, like other mess. The hygiene is properly maintained.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: College is good if you can work hard, it can bring you a good amount of opportunities.

content.Placements: Placements are average, not very good, but you can get enough opportunities if you can skill up yourself. According to the college placement cell, the recent batch has the highest package offer, which is 21 LPA, and the average package is approximately 6.5 LPA, which is quite average. But you can get opportunities to grab.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities are above average. The infrastructure for CSE depth of 1st year is not good since there are no AC in classrooms, but some labs are air-conditioned. Wi-Fi speed is average, not up to the mark. The hostel is good, and the mess food is edible till now. The library is top class with good infrastructure, fully air-conditioned, and a wide range of books and newspapers are available.

Application forms for all the courses are available online on the institute’s official website. If a candidate wants to apply offline, they can contact the admission office. Once the exams have been conducted, results are declared and the counselling process is completed, candidates are selected based on their merit in the exam. If they clear all the criteria, they are selected and informed. However, to confirm the seat, candidates must pay theJSS Noida fees.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure with a green campus and decent hostels, supportive faculty.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure are like a green campus and decent hostel including Wi-Fi, a classroom with projectors and a library. The quality of hostel food is moderate not too bad contains four meals and hostels also have medical support 24/7, including outdoor and indoor games.

reviews.review_heading: Hoping for a better placement rate in JSS, good infrastructure, and focus on skills.
reviews.review_text: For infrastructure, I would say neither is too good like IIT, NIT, IIMs infra, nor too bad like other tier-2 colleges. Hostel infrastructure is better both for boys and girls. Even though the capacity is low and the buildings are old, it is a better place for B.Tech students.

reviews.review_heading: Harsh reality of JSSATE Noida.
reviews.review_text: Labs are not well equipped like a typical government college. Hostels are decent; you will get both AC and non-AC rooms. Mess food is very bad, but I prefer the college hostel at least in the first year. This college is not for you if you love sports and games, no proper facilities are there.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied because of the faculty, good placement and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is overall good. The labs are well. The library has AC, with good environment for studying. The hostel facility is okay. The bathrooms are not well furnished and mostly have construction issues. The food quality is okay, like other mess. The hygiene is properly maintained.

reviews.review_heading: College is good if you can work hard, it can bring you a good amount of opportunities.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are above average. The infrastructure for CSE depth of 1st year is not good since there are no AC in classrooms, but some labs are air-conditioned. Wi-Fi speed is average, not up to the mark. The hostel is good, and the mess food is edible till now. The library is top class with good infrastructure, fully air-conditioned, and a wide range of books and newspapers are available.

reviews.review_heading: Ample facilities but infrastructure from inside is much desired.
reviews.review_text: From outside, it looks good, but inside, classes are a little shabby, and roads are well paved, with an abundance of parking spaces. You also get Wi-Fi for all students, great library access, and well-built labs. There are hostels with AC and without AC. The choice is yours and also depends on availability.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure, facilities, teachers, and everything.
reviews.review_text: Very good facilities of Wi-Fi, library, classrooms, and labs are available. There are the best hostels ever, with bigger rooms, Wi-Fi connection, and good food. They have 3 shared rooms and a single room, and have AC and non-AC rooms. They provide vegetarian food and snacks. They have a water cooler and a filter also.

reviews.review_heading: A complete review of my college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is what makes it stand above the rest. It has top-notch hostel facilities and good and spacious classrooms. The infrastructure stands at the top of the list. In our hostels, we have both AC hostel (ISH) and non-AC hostel (BH). Both the hostels have quality rooms.

reviews.review_heading: The college has a great infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: On campus, hostels are available, including both air-conditioned and non-air-conditioned options. Veg foods are served in the mess, while non-veg foods are not on the menu. Sports facilities are also available on campus, providing great opportunities.

reviews.review_heading: Average college with a good location advantage.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms do not have ACs or even smart boards. Teachers are using old-style blackboards The labs are fine and you can get Wi-Fi access for your laptop. The hostels are good with all the facilities, the mess food is also eatable and on some days, it could be great too.

reviews.review_heading: Review of JSS Academy of Technical Education.
reviews.review_text: There is a separate building for every course or department. Every department has its own library, labs, Wi-Fi, halls, and many classrooms. Hostel is good because you have a choice of rooms. You can choose a deluxe hostel room or a simple hostel room. But the food is average. There are many sports. You can play in your hostel as well as in college.

reviews.review_heading: College is very good and no disappointments.
reviews.review_text: There are very nice infrastructure in the college and good libraries are present where we get the articles to read nice books for pharmacy are provided. Sports events are done per year. The food canteen is very good with good hostel facilities and good mess food.

reviews.review_heading: College is overall good if you are a brilliant, but not for below-average students
reviews.review_text: Everything was good, but classrooms are not fully equipped as AC is not provided by the college. The library is good, and there is a motivating environment for study. Sports and canteen facilities are available, but medical facilities are not. The campus is Wi-Fi enabled, and there is an auditorium and transport services available.

reviews.review_heading: JSS’s honest truth with all its upsides and downsides, so don’t miss it.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms aren’t air-conditioned and are really suffocating in the summer. But the library is fully air-conditioned and Wi-Fi is okay. The girls’ hostel is really good; it has both AC and non-AC rooms, the food is good and hygienic, and there are sports facilities. The labs have AC and are well-equipped.

reviews.review_heading: JSS, Noida is still relevant in 2025.
reviews.review_text: Hostel food is below average and quality degrades in night food. Hostel life is good, with sufficient campus area for any sports. There are school-like classrooms with no AC and coolers, classes become bad in the summers, and decent infrastructure still needs improvement.

review_summary.college_name: JSS Science and Technology University Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Review of Sri Jayachamarajendra College of Engineering, JSS STU.

content.Placements: Good companies do come for placements, and it is the single best pro of this college. This year, the average package offered is around 11 LPA, with CSE leading in terms of employment and the highest package. The number of companies coming for internships is good. An ample chance is given for students to get internships.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel is dirty and neglected. Cleanliness does not exist for the warden. Our college lab facilities are decent and well-equipped. Notably, the golden jubilee block is the best out of all. Sports facilities are good since the college is huge. An in-house gym is available too, which is free for the college students.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Great placement, average infrastructure, and a peaceful campus.

content.Placements: The placement rates of our college are pretty great, 80 to 90 percent of students got placed last year. This year the highest package offered is 40LPA. Among IT related Branch CSE, AIML, ISE, CSBS, the average package offered is around 13 to 14 LPA, and the median package is above 12LPA.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure and facilities provided by our college are below average. The main CSE building, Golden Jubilee Bhavan, and the admin block are great, but the rest of the buildings are pretty average. For freshers, they conduct classes in the Polymer Science building, whose classrooms are pretty bad. They really need to improve it.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Computer Applications (MCA) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Good to go. Need to concentrate more on placements than the attendance and just the book knowledge.

content.Placements: I am a student of batch 2024-2025. In my batch, the placement numbers are decent. Out of 120 students, around 35 students got placed, where the average package is 5-6 LPA and the lowest package is 3 LPA. Top recruiters include TCS, Infosys, and others.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is above average. Each class had projectors and all labs had fast internet connection. Coming to the hostel, I'll rate it 3.5. The food is sometimes good and sometimes bad. Gymnasium is good. Importance is given to sports and physical education.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Computer Applications (MCA) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: One of the best colleges in Mysore, if you are willing to do MCA.

content.Placements: According to my knowledge, in our MCA batch, around 80-85% of students were placed through campus placements. The highest package offered was around 12.4 LPA, while the lowest was 3.5 LPA, and the average package stayed around 5-6 LPA. Top recruiting companies included TCS, Infosys, Wipro, LTIMindtree, Accenture, Capgemini, Cognizant, and Bosch. Nearly 60% of the students also got internships in companies like TCS, Infosys, startups, and analytics-based organizations, mostly in roles like software development, web development, and testing.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Business System - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: JSS Science and Technology Mysuru review and 2026 placement.

content.Placements: The placements of this college are decent. The average package you can expect in this college is around 10 to 11 LPA, and the median is around 9 to 9.5 LPA. The overall placement percentage is around 80 percent, including all branches. Around 90 percent of students in CSE-related branches are placed.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of this college is good. Since this is an old established college, the infrastructure is outdated compared to other colleges through CET or COMEDK. It is an old-styled college. But the hostel facilities are very good, as the hostels are newly built.

The college offers more than ten courses (including specialisation) in Engineering & Business and Management streams. labs.description: Available Facilities: Chemistry Lab, Computer Lab, Electrical Lab, Electronics Lab, Mechanical Lab, Physics Lab, Networks Lab, Operating System Lab, Electrical Machine Lab, Electrical Circuits Lab, Control and Instrumentation Lab

reviews.review_heading: Good college if you really want to study.
reviews.review_text: Hostel is so good, and maintenance is also good. Food is average. Any difficulty or problem with the electrical side, they take immediate action to solve the problem. Only food is not much better. They provide us with average food. They provide non-veg weekly for 4 days.

reviews.review_heading: College is strict and has good facilities, but the faculty and events need improvement.
reviews.review_text: College infrastructure is well maintained with clean classrooms well equipped labs and a library stocked with sufficient books. WiFi facilities are available across the campus especially in the labs and library. The hostel is decent and well maintained with clean and comfortable rooms. The food provided in the hostel mess is average but there is a canteen on campus for snacks. Medical facilities are available within the campus and students can participate in sports such as cricket volleyball and...

reviews.review_heading: I am dissatisfied with the food in the hostel.
reviews.review_text: Hostel rooms and maintenance are good. The food they provide is not that good. We have to report the fault in the room, and the hostel management will take action in a short time. They don't take more time to solve the fault. Only the food is limited and not that good. Weekly, 4 days, non-vegetarian food is served. It provides snacks in the evening.

reviews.review_heading: Facilities were good and excellent.
reviews.review_text: My college has a good network, providing high-speed Wi-Fi connection and internet access across campus. There is modern equipment for hands-on learning in Science, engineering, and specialized research. Classrooms have digital boards, projectors, and comfortable seating to enhance learning. There is also a vast collection of books in libraries, journals, and research papers, often with online access to e-resources.

reviews.review_heading: An honest review about K. Ramakrishnan College of Engineering.
reviews.review_text: If you talk about the facilities and infrastructure, there are Wi-Fi connections all over our college campus and also facilitated classrooms and a library with thousands of books. If we talk about the quality of our hostel, it may be something average because the food was so low, and not many students studied in the hostel.

reviews.review_heading: A small review of K Ramakrishnan College of Engineering from my point of view.
reviews.review_text: Our classrooms were clean and neat. Also, most labs are available, and there are good libraries with a large number of books. When you talk about the hostel, there may be small food problems in our college, like the quality, but otherwise, the food was good. Maybe small issues happen sometimes. Medical facilities are available 24/7, and the canteen food was good.

reviews.review_heading: If you need to gain knowledge, its a good place but not for your freedom.
reviews.review_text: In my college, infrastructure is better. Hostel facility is not good. In our college, we have canteen facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Good college and environment .
reviews.review_text: The facilities in our college are the best. In our department, Wi-Fi facilities are provided, and labs are well-equipped. Classrooms are clean, and libraries have many books where we need to give ID cards for books. The quality of food is good in the canteen and mess.

reviews.review_heading: Many students are friends of mine in this college.
reviews.review_text: The facilities in our college are very good. The college infrastructure is excellent, with a pleasant and well-lit environment. We have Wi-Fi access, well-equipped labs, and a library. Hostel facilities are also good, and the food is satisfactory.

reviews.review_heading: Golden days of my college life .
reviews.review_text: Courses are good in the college, and also campus life is too good and neat when compared to a hostel. In a hostel, the total control is taken by Zolo Stays, so it is very neat and clean. And they will provide free popcorn with theatre-type movies for everyone once a week, and also they cut the cake for the hostel students free of cost.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with the college environment and facilities .
reviews.review_text: Our college has a huge library. Each department has separate labs. Each floor has separate Wi-Fi, and classrooms have educom facilities. The college hostel has AC and non-AC facilities, and the mess food is moderate. Separate the canteen for vegetarians and non-vegetarians. Our college has a separate sports club, and they support the students to participate in various events.

reviews.review_heading: It is an okay college, but not that good.
reviews.review_text: The facilities available are Wi-Fi, labs, and computers. But they can improve some more. The library has a reasonable number of books. The quality of the rooms is okay. But the AC rooms are so good. But food is not that good. It is spicier in nature. They use ready-made parathas and chapatis.

reviews.review_heading: How is life at KRCE Trichy?
reviews.review_text: Labs and classrooms are non AC, and hostel rooms and foods are not that much worthy. Ill rate it around 6.5 to 10. canteen has absolutely tasty and catch foods, which is worth the hype krce. When it comes to sports, no sports quota will be considered here. But they will give you cash rewards if you won any prize. I ve got 25k for being selected for anna university women volleyball team 2023 and I had participated in all india south zone tournament which was held at Kerala on dec 2022. they will ...

reviews.review_heading: Education is a good weapon for future.
reviews.review_text: The campus infrastructure is looking good. It was very clean and green with filled of trees. Our campus is maintained by the NSS Cubs. There are two blocks in our campus separately one for Engineering and other for Technology block. Wi-fi facilities are also provided in our classrooms and labs.

reviews.review_heading: KRCE placements and training review.
reviews.review_text: The students are handled in a friendly way and are given opportunities to participate in the inter and intra college events. Hostels are very comfortable and well maintained at all times. The quality of food is very nice and we like the food prepared in the mess.
